scripts.translation: 我們要怎樣才能讓這些噩夢

scripts.text: I told you it's difficult for me to look at those soldiers without feeling pain.
scripts.translation: 消失？看著那些士兵，我心裡實在不好受。

scripts.text: Would you be so kind as to put them to rest for me?

scripts.text: I really don't want to deal with them myself,

I'll leave the ^0000FFAngry Soldiers^000000 to you.
Are you with the subjugation party?
Why can't you just leave us alone?
scripts.translation: 為什麼就不能放過我們？

scripts.text: The light... The magic... Please stop that magic...
Are you here to subjugate us?!
Can't you tell from the sacred creatures!
scripts.translation: ！那些聖獸還不能說明一切嗎？

scripts.text: You! You're no better than them!
scripts.translation: 你！你和他們根本沒兩樣！

scripts.text: What have we done to you?
scripts.translation: 我們究竟對你做了什麼？

scripts.text: Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?
scripts.translation: 你確定拿得動這麼多東西嗎？先清一下背包吧？

scripts.text: Mm, you're an adventurer. What brings you to me? I'm sorry, I'm kind of busy. Could you talk to the priest over there instead?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你是冒險者啊。找我有什麼事？抱歉，我正忙著。能去和那邊的神父談談嗎？

scripts.text: The notebook... I want to see the notebook... If you want to enter the notebook, then you should talk to Father Grimm. If you want, I can go with you.
scripts.translation: 筆記本......我想看看那本筆記本......想進去的話就去找格林神父談談。你願意的話，我可以陪你去。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but I can't talk right now. I'm too busy examining the things you brought to me.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在沒空說話，正忙著檢查你帶來的東西。

scripts.text: Could you come back after dawn?

scripts.translation: 你好，冒險者，最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Whew, I stayed up all night examining the Dried Yggdrasil Leaves and the Suspicious Pentacles. I wouldn't have to, if Father Grimm left me alone.
scripts.translation: 呼，我通宵檢查了乾枯的世界樹葉和可疑的五芒星。要不是格林神父一直管著我，我根本用不著熬夜。

scripts.text: Anyway they're so old and poorly preserved that they easily crumble to dust. I couldn't finish my research.
scripts.translation: 總之，這些東西太古老，儲存得也很差，一碰就碎成粉末。我的研究沒法繼續了。

scripts.text: So I'm thinking... Could you bring me some more today? I need ^0000cd10 Dried Yggdrasil Leaves and 10 Suspicious Pentacles^000000.
scripts.translation: 所以我想......今天能再幫我帶些來嗎？我需要10片乾枯的世界樹葉和10個可疑的五芒星。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Also, please hunt 5 zombies of each kind for that nagging priest.
scripts.translation: 另外，幫那位嘮叨的神父每種腐屍都獵殺5只吧。

scripts.text: In the meantime I'll catch some Z's.
Adventurer, how did you feel when you touched the notebook? How do you think it works?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你碰那本筆記本時是什麼感覺？你覺得它是怎麼運作的？

scripts.text: I've got so many questions, but that mean priest wouldn't let me touch it.
scripts.translation: 我有一堆問題，可那個討厭的神父就是不讓我碰它。

scripts.text: Adventurer, could you take me with you the next time you enter the notebook? I swear I'm not going to steal the notebook. I'm just really curious about it.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，下次你進筆記本時能帶我一起去嗎？我保證不偷筆記本，只是實在太好奇了。

scripts.text: I can hear you. Give up your obsession with it. That would be best for you.
scripts.translation: 我聽得見。別再對它這麼著迷了，這樣對你最好。

scripts.text: Who says I'm obsessed with it?
Adventurer, please? Don't I look pitiful?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，幫幫我嘛？你看我多可憐。

scripts.text: What do you want to know the most?
I don't want to get between you two.
Sorry, but I don't want to get between you two. You both have a point, and I can't side with either one of you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不想夾在你們中間。你們說得都有道理，我沒法偏袒任何一方。

scripts.text: Hmpf, alright, but if you ever feel pity for me, then come back and help me. Promise?
scripts.translation: 哼，好吧。不過你哪天要是可憐我，就回來幫幫我。說好了？

scripts.text: About those walking corpses, of course!
I really want to know what keeps them moving, what kind of experiments my predecessors did on them, and what kind of state they're in.
scripts.translation: 我很想知道是什麼讓它們繼續活動、我的前輩們對它們做過什麼實驗，以及它們現在是什麼狀態。

scripts.text: Such experiments are prohibited now, and all the old records were destroyed.
scripts.translation: 現在這類實驗已經被禁止，過去的記錄也全都銷燬了。

scripts.text: They were destroyed for good reason. So stop wondering about them.
scripts.translation: 銷燬它們自有原因。別再打聽了。

scripts.text: Oh, that's right! Adventurer, could you capture a zombie for me? Alive, that is.
scripts.translation: 對了！冒險者，你能幫我抓一隻活的腐屍嗎？

scripts.text: No. Don't even think about it. Mojo, you're so close to crossing the line.
scripts.translation: 不行，想都別想。莫喬，你已經快要越界了。

scripts.text: I wasn't asking you! Unless you're going to let me touch the notebook, stay out of my hair!
scripts.translation: 我又沒問你！除非你肯讓我碰筆記本，否則少管我！

scripts.text: You just asked this adventurer to capture a zombie alive.
scripts.translation: 你剛才明明讓這位冒險者去抓一隻活腐屍。

scripts.text: You're not thinking about what kind of danger it might pose when it arrives here. You just want it because you're curious about it.
scripts.translation: 你根本沒考慮把它帶回來會有多危險，只是因為好奇才想要它。

scripts.text: Did you forget why Brother Jojo wanted you to stay here and stay away from the notebook?
scripts.translation: 你忘了喬喬兄弟為什麼讓你留在這裡、別碰那本筆記本嗎？

scripts.text: So I'm asking this adventurer. You keep telling me don't do this, don't do that. Is there anything I can do without you saying no?
scripts.translation: 所以我才問這位冒險者啊。你總是什麼都不讓我做。難道就沒有一件事是你不會反對的嗎？

scripts.text: You can't bring anything from the world inside the book. If you do, I'll get rid of them.
scripts.translation: 書中世界的東西一件也不許帶出來。要是帶了，我會把它們處理掉。

scripts.text: If you really want to experiment on those blasphemous creatures, then I suggest you talk with Brother Jojo and the others first.
scripts.translation: 你真想研究那些褻瀆生命的生物，就先去和喬喬兄弟他們商量。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I read in the notebook that the owner used some materials to experiment on zombies. I think they're Yggdrasil leaves and some drawings.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，我在筆記本里看到，主人曾用一些材料研究腐屍。我想是世界樹葉和某種圖案。

scripts.text: You mean dried Yggdrasil leaves and some pentacles.
scripts.translation: 你是說乾枯的世界樹葉和五芒星嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. Could you at least procure them for me?
scripts.translation: 對。至少能幫我弄到這些嗎？

scripts.text: Maybe I can use them to figure out the experiment she did and the force that reanimates the dead.
scripts.translation: 也許我能借此查明她做過什麼實驗，以及是什麼力量讓死者重新活動。

scripts.text: Why are you obsessed with this? Do you really want to let these unholy creature loose on the continent? Do you not understand why the Tower has banned the experiments?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼這麼執著？真想把這些邪惡的生物放出來禍害大陸嗎？你不明白中央塔為何禁止這類實驗嗎？

scripts.text: Look, I'm not going to experiment on the zombies. I just want to take a look at the materials she used.
scripts.translation: 聽著，我不會拿腐屍做實驗，只是想看看她用過的材料。

scripts.text: And who knows? I might find out a way to exterminate these zombies at once.
scripts.translation: 再說了，說不定我能找到一舉消滅這些腐屍的方法呢。

scripts.text: You agreed that our enthusiasm for magic has contributed to the development of our country.
scripts.translation: 你也承認過，我們對魔法的熱忱推動了國家的發展。

scripts.text: I promise I'm not going to do anything dangerous. I'll just take a look at the materials.
scripts.translation: 我保證不做危險的事，只看看那些材料。

scripts.text: And you will stop asking me for this notebook, yes?
scripts.translation: 那你也會答應不再向我要這本筆記本了？

scripts.text: Huh? But that's... I'd love to take a look at it.
scripts.translation: 啊？可是......我還是很想看看。

scripts.text: So have you come to an agreement?
Yes, we have. Please bring me some dried Yggdrasil leaves and pentacles. 10 for each sounds good.
scripts.translation: 談妥了。請幫我帶些乾枯的世界樹葉和五芒星來，每樣10個就行。

scripts.text: Mm, I'm not sure yet. Do you mind if I ask you for more later? Okay, then please bring me ^0000cd10 Dried Yggdrasil Leaves and 10 Suspicious Pentacles^000000.
scripts.translation: 嗯，還不確定。之後再找你要一些，你不介意吧？那就請帶來10片乾枯的世界樹葉和10個可疑的五芒星。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, and while you're at it, could you hunt some zombies for that scowling priest as well? Just 5 of each kind. I don't want to burden you.
scripts.translation: 哦，順便也幫那位愁眉苦臉的神父獵殺一些腐屍吧，每種5只就行。我不想給你添太多麻煩。

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for doing this for us.
Adventurer, welcome back! I've been waiting for you for so long! Did you bring the things I asked? Come on, let me see them!
scripts.translation: 冒險者，歡迎回來！我等你好久了！要的東西帶來了嗎？快拿給我看看！

scripts.text: Wow, these are so old and fragile, I'm afraid they might crumble in my hands.
scripts.translation: 哇，這些東西又老又脆，我怕一拿就碎了。

scripts.text: Are you happy now? They don't look any different from the ones you're using, though.
scripts.translation: 你現在滿意了吧？不過看起來和你手頭那些沒什麼區別。

scripts.text: You priests are the least curious kind I know. I asked for these because I wanted to compare them to the ones I have, and it takes a keen eye to catch minute differences.
scripts.translation: 你們這些牧師真是我見過最好奇心最差的一群人。我讓你拿這些來，是想和我手頭的樣本比較。要發現細微差異，可得有雙敏銳的眼睛。

scripts.text: Adventurer, could you bring me some more tomorrow? I'm worried I might end up damaging all these you brought today. Even if I don't, I can always use more samples.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，明天能再帶一些來嗎？我怕今天這些樣本會被我弄壞。就算沒弄壞，多些樣本也總有用。

scripts.text: Thank you so much. See you tomorrow!
Adventurer, welcome back! I've been waiting for you for so long! Did you bring the things I asked? Come on, let me see them!
scripts.translation: 冒險者，歡迎回來！我等你好久了！要的東西帶來了嗎？快拿給我看看！

scripts.text: Mm, this isn't enough. Please bring me ^0000cd10 Dried Yggdrasil Leaves and 10 Suspicious Pentacles^000000.
scripts.translation: 嗯，還不夠。請再帶來10片乾枯的世界樹葉和10個可疑的五芒星。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Also, could you hunt 5 zombies of each kind for that scowling priest over there? Thanks!
scripts.translation: 另外，能幫那邊那位嚴肅的神父每種腐屍都獵殺5只嗎？謝謝！

scripts.text: Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?
scripts.translation: 你確定拿得動這麼多東西嗎？清一清背包吧。

scripts.text: This place is too dangerous for you. Pleae come back when you're stronger.
scripts.translation: 這裡對你來說太危險了。等你變強些再來吧。

scripts.text: Just let me read it. I'll go bring them out afterward. Please?
scripts.translation: 先讓我讀讀嘛。我之後會把它們帶出來的。求你了？

scripts.text: Just leave me alone! I know you're going to run away with it if I give it to you.
scripts.translation: 別煩我！我才不會把它交給你，因為我知道你拿到後肯定會帶著它逃跑。

scripts.text: I swear I'll give it back to you. Just for one minute. How about thirty seconds? Ten seconds, then?
scripts.translation: 我保證會還給你。就看一分鐘。三十秒怎麼樣？十秒也行！

scripts.text: No! I'm not even going to let you touch it!
scripts.translation: 不行！我連碰都不讓你碰！

scripts.text: Come on, it's me, Mojo. Don't you trust me?
scripts.translation: 拜託啦，是我，莫喬。你還不信我嗎？

scripts.text: No, I don't. I may trust Mojo, my sister in faith, but not Mojo, the mage.
scripts.translation: 不，我不信。作為信仰中的姐妹，我或許信任莫喬；但作為魔法師，我可不信她。

scripts.text: Oh, come on! You're a priest? You're supposed to have faith in everyone! Why are you treating me like a thief?
scripts.translation: 真是的！你可是牧師，應該相信所有人吧！為什麼把我當賊防著？

scripts.text: I only have faith in Him, and He's telling me not to trust you.
scripts.translation: 我只信奉主，而主告訴我別相信你。

scripts.text: Of course not. Only His servants can hear him.
scripts.translation: 那當然，只有主的僕人才聽得見祂的聲音。

scripts.text: Would you be so kind as to heal me?
Sure thing. Any time you want, {0}
Thank you. I'm sorry, but I've heard you fighting, even from that far corner of this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。抱歉，我剛才在地牢另一頭都聽見你們吵架了。

scripts.text: You have? We must have been really loud. I suppose that wasn't very smart of us.
scripts.translation: 你聽見了？看來我們聲音確實太大了，真不該這樣。

scripts.text: Oh, this is great! Instead of fighting, why don't we ask this adventurer who is right?
scripts.translation: 太好了！別吵了，不如問問這位冒險者誰有理？

scripts.text: Adventurer, if you're not busy, would you hear us out?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你要是不忙，願意聽聽我們怎麼回事嗎？

scripts.text: I see. It's a shame that you can't seize on such a great opportunity.
scripts.translation: 這樣啊。真可惜，你錯過了這麼好的機會。

scripts.text: Please feel free to come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 改變主意的話，隨時可以回來。

scripts.text: Okay, this is going to be a long story. Let me have some water first.
scripts.translation: 好吧，這故事有點長。讓我先喝口水。

scripts.text: Adventurer, did you know these catacombs under Geffen once were quiet and filled with special energy instead of monsters?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你知道嗎？吉芬地下的墓穴以前很安靜，充滿了特殊能量，而不是魔物橫行的地方。

scripts.text: Back then, only a couple of monsters showed up once every decade or so.
scripts.translation: 那時大約十年才會出現幾隻魔物。

scripts.text: Why are you looking at me?
Some mages decided to erect an ivory tower of their own. They searched everywhere in the continent and settled on the ground above these catacombs.
scripts.translation: 有些魔法師決定建造一座屬於自己的象牙塔。他們踏遍大陸各處，最後選中了這片墓穴上方的土地。

scripts.text: That was the beginning of the tragedy.
It's been said all mammals have curiosity that rivals their appetite, but mages... are the worst.
scripts.translation: 據說所有哺乳動物的好奇心都不輸食慾，但魔法師......最是過分。

scripts.text: Anyway, these mages, after they built the Geffen Tower, took notice of the blasphemous creatures that sometimes appeared in the catacombs.
scripts.translation: 總之，吉芬塔建成後，那些魔法師注意到墓穴裡偶爾出現的邪惡生物。

scripts.text: They conducted various experiments to understand the special energy that reanimated the dead.
scripts.translation: 他們開始進行各種實驗，試圖弄清是什麼特殊能量讓死者復甦。

scripts.text: And as if that wasn't enough, those mages used their magic and replicated the reanimating process.
scripts.translation: 還不止如此，那些魔法師甚至用魔法複製了死者復甦的過程。

scripts.text: That went horribly wrong. The special energy that surrounded the catacombs exploded, bringing back all the dead buried in them.
scripts.translation: 結果釀成大禍。墓穴周圍的特殊能量爆發，埋在裡面的死者全都復活了。

scripts.text: Those arrogant mages crossed the line! They tried to play God!
scripts.translation: 那些傲慢的魔法師越了界！他們竟想扮演上帝！

scripts.text: Hey, I'm one of them, and I'm not going to let you talk bad about my predecessors like that!
scripts.translation: 喂，我也是魔法師，你別這樣詆譭我的前輩！

scripts.text: How am I defaming them when I'm only telling the truth?
scripts.translation: 我只是在說實話，怎麼能算詆譭？

scripts.text: What do you think, Adventurer? Would you trust someone so reckless with important tasks?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你怎麼看？你會把重要任務交給這麼魯莽的人嗎？

scripts.text: But wait, Adventurer. You haven't heard my side of the story.
scripts.translation: 等等，冒險者。你還沒聽我怎麼說呢。

scripts.text: We understand the things that we want to study can be dangerous, so we try our best to be careful.
scripts.translation: 我們知道研究的物件可能很危險，所以一直盡力謹慎行事。

scripts.text: My predecessors may have been too enthusiastic to study what's underneath their tower, but it was that enthusiasm that made Geffen grow into the city of magic that it is.
scripts.translation: 我的前輩們研究塔下的事物時或許過於熱衷，但正是這份熱忱讓吉芬發展成瞭如今的魔法之都。

scripts.text: Rune-Midgarts is flanked by Arunafeltz and Schwarzwald, the two strongest nations of the continent, and its magic power is what keeps them at bay.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲夾在大陸上最強大的兩個國家阿魯納菲茲與修瓦魯茲巴爾德之間。正是魔法的力量讓他們不敢輕舉妄動。

scripts.text: And that's the only reason that kept the Church from further pressing this matter,
scripts.translation: 教會沒有繼續追究此事，也正是因為這個原因，

scripts.text: even though it doesn't change the fact that you woke the dead.
scripts.translation: 儘管你們喚醒死者的事實依然無法改變。

scripts.text: Curiosity is what fuels our life. It's the seed of development. Adventurer, would you hesitate to go to a new world because it's dangerous?
scripts.translation: 好奇心是生命的動力，也是進步的源泉。冒險者，你會因為新世界很危險就不敢前往嗎？

scripts.text: I wouldn't be an adventurer if I did.
scripts.translation: 要是會猶豫，我就當不了冒險者了。

scripts.text: We mages are just like you adventurers in that sense. I knew you'd understand me.
scripts.translation: 從這點來說，我們魔法師和你們冒險者一樣。我就知道你會理解我。

scripts.text: You heard that, Father Grimm. Now show me the notebook.
scripts.translation: 你聽到了吧，格林神父？現在把筆記本給我看看。

scripts.text: No. Adventurer, you agreed with me that she's not trustworthy.
scripts.translation: 不行。冒險者，你剛才也同意她不值得信任。

scripts.text: You also agreed with me on the value of curiosity.
scripts.translation: 你也贊同好奇心的價值啊。
所以這到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: I've heard both of you, but neither of you told me what you were fighting for.
scripts.translation: 我聽了你們雙方的說法，可你們都沒告訴我到底在爭什麼。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry. The Church of Rune-Midgarts periodically sends its priests out to these catacombs to maintain peace.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。盧恩·米德加茲教會會定期派牧師到這些地下墓穴維持秩序。

scripts.text: I'm one of them, and I happened to pick up a ^0000cdnotebook^000000 just before you found us.
scripts.translation: 我就是其中之一。在你們找到我們之前，我剛好撿到一本筆記本。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes. It looks like it belongs to one of the Geffen Tower mages. It has ^0000cdBomi^000000 written on its cover, which I think is the name of its owner.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，看起來屬於吉芬塔的一位魔法師。封面寫著波米，我想那應該是主人的名字。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But none of my guildsmen has such a name. I read the book, and she did sound like she was one of us. ^0000cdNot anymore^000000, though.
scripts.translation: 可我的公會裡沒有人叫這個名字。我讀過筆記，她聽起來確實是我們魔法師的一員，不過現在已經不是了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You're pretty sharp, Adventurer. That's right. I checked with my guild and found out there was someone named Bomi. She just disappeared one day, though.
scripts.translation: 你挺敏銳的，冒險者。沒錯，我問過公會，確實有個叫波米的人，只是她有一天突然失蹤了。

scripts.text: Do you think this notebook belongs to her? But why was it here?
scripts.translation: 你覺得筆記本是她的？可它為什麼會在這裡？

scripts.text: That was the same question we asked at first. That didn't matter anymore once we read what was written in the book.
scripts.translation: 我們一開始也這麼問過。不過讀了裡面的內容後，這個問題就沒那麼重要了。

scripts.text: What's written in it is unsettling, but what's more serious is? You'll have to read it yourself. Just don't open the ^0000cdlast page^000000.
scripts.translation: 裡面寫的東西令人不安，但更嚴重的是......你得親自讀一讀。只是別翻開最後一頁。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: So you're okay with this adventurer reading it, but not me.
scripts.translation: 所以你讓這位冒險者看，卻不讓我看？

scripts.text: I placed my hand on the book Father Grimm was holding. Suddenly I felt dizzy as the air around me shimmered. Carefully, I opened the notebook.
scripts.translation: 我把手放到格林神父手中的筆記本上。突然一陣眩暈，周圍的空氣閃爍起來。我小心地翻開了筆記本。

scripts.text: I fainted in the middle of learning a new spell, again.
scripts.translation: 我又在學習新法術時暈倒了。體力

scripts.text: My low stamina and insufficient mana are always the problem. I thought I could make up for my weak constitution with magic. Of course, even that required some minimal stamina, but I didn't have even that.
scripts.translation: 太差、魔力不足，總是拖我後腿。我以為魔法能彌補孱弱的體質，可施法至少也得有點體力，而我連這點力氣都沒有。我太累了.

scripts.text: I saw Sophia drinking a mana potion. Maybe potions are the answer to my never-ending search for physical support.
scripts.translation: 我看見索菲婭喝了魔力藥水。也許藥水能解決我一直以來體力不足的問題

scripts.text: I wonder if there are special potions that could improve me physically. Then, I could become stronger at last.
scripts.translation: 。有沒有能增強體質的特殊藥水呢？如果有，我終於就能變強了。

scripts.text: All the potions I found didn't help improve my weak constitution. All they do is boost strength that's already there.
scripts.translation: 我找到的藥水都沒能改善孱弱的體質，只能增強本來就有的力量。也許

scripts.text: Maybe I should try to formulate stamina and mana potions on my own.
scripts.translation: 我該試著自己調配體力藥水和魔力藥水。

scripts.text: I learned about the catacombs under the Geffen Tower while I was in the library, reading about the tower's history.
scripts.translation: 我在圖書館查閱吉芬塔的歷史時，得知塔下有一片地下墓穴。死者

scripts.text: How are the dead reanimated? What kind of vital force keeps them moving?
scripts.translation: 如何復甦？是什麼力量讓他們繼續活動？

scripts.text: I need permission to enter the catacombs. I'm going to check them tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 我得申請進入墓穴的許可。明天就去看看。

scripts.text: The dead don't talk. There's nothing I can find out from them.
scripts.translation: 死者不會說話，我從他們身上問不出任

scripts.text: I've found traces of experiments everywhere. Some of my peers must have been here before I have.
scripts.translation: 何線索。我到處都發現了實驗痕跡，肯定有同伴比我更早來

scripts.text: I'm especially tired today. I'm going to bed early tonight.
scripts.translation: 過。今天格外疲憊，今晚早點睡。

scripts.text: The bats in the catacombs drink blood from the zombies, probably because there's nothing else to eat.
scripts.translation: 墓穴裡的蝙蝠吸食腐屍的血，大概是因為沒有其他食物。我每天都

scripts.text: Every day, I spend most of my energy keeping the bloodthirsty bats at bay. I'd get killed if I didn't stay near the exit.
scripts.translation: 得耗費大半精力驅趕那些嗜血蝙蝠。要是不待在出口附近，恐怕早就沒命了。我

scripts.text: Today, I heard some strange noise in the catacombs. The zombies and bats were strangely quiet.
scripts.translation: 今天我在地下墓穴裡聽見了奇怪的聲響，腐屍和蝙蝠也反常

scripts.text: Maybe I should explore deeper into the catacombs tomorrow, while the monsters hide from whatever that noise is.
scripts.translation: 地安靜。也許明天趁魔物躲著那聲音時，我該再往墓穴深處看看。

scripts.text: That was the last entry. I took my hand off the notebook. Father Grimm closed the notebook.
scripts.translation: 最後一篇日記到此為止。我把手從筆記本上移開，格林神父隨即合上了它。

scripts.text: This is notebook is both ^0000cda diary and research journal^000000.
scripts.translation: 這本筆記既是日記，也是研究記錄。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Indeed. It shows how its owner studied those blasphemous creatures to ^0000cdcreate stamina and mana enhancers^000000.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。裡面記載了筆記本的主人如何研究那些邪惡生物，並製作體力和魔力增強劑。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes, it is. My guild would love to study this notebook. Most records from the same era have been lost.
scripts.translation: 確實有意思。我的公會很想研究這本筆記。同一時期的大多數記錄都已經失傳了。

scripts.text: The content of this notebook isn't what causes me alarm. Didn't you detect some ^0000cdstrange energy^000000 when you touch it?
scripts.translation: 讓我不安的不是筆記裡的內容。你碰它時，沒察覺到一股奇怪的能量嗎？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: This book is sustained with its owner's spiritual energy, and it's pulling those who gaze upon it into ^0000cdthe world inside it^000000.
scripts.translation: 這本筆記由主人殘留的精神力量維繫，會把注視它的人吸進書中的世界。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And that's why I want to see the notebook so badly. I want to know how it contains a world inside it and why it was only discovered now.
scripts.translation: 所以我才這麼想看這本筆記。我想知道它如何容納一個世界，以及為什麼直到現在才被發現。

scripts.text: Mage, you stay out of this! This notebook is taking people to some place we don't know. And the gateway is in the last page.
scripts.translation: 魔法師，別插手！這本筆記會把人帶到未知之地，而入口就在最後一頁。

scripts.text: I scanned it for any malicious intent, but I didn't sense any. I think its owner just ^0000cdneeds help with some unfinished business^000000.
scripts.translation: 我檢查過它是否懷有惡意，卻沒有察覺到任何惡意。我想主人只是有些未了之事需要幫忙。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: So were you arguing about which one of you should go to that place?
scripts.translation: 所以你們是在爭誰該去那個地方嗎？

scripts.text: No. The other members of my group and two mages are already there. They just haven't returned.
scripts.translation: 不是。我小隊的其他成員和兩位魔法師已經進去了，只是還沒回來。

scripts.text: You? Well, you're more reliable than this sister here, but are you sure?
scripts.translation: 你？嗯，你比這位修女可靠些，不過你確定要去嗎？

scripts.text: I want to repay you for healing me. Also, after listening to you both, I think it's better I go. Do you want me to go bring back your colleagues?
scripts.translation: 你治好了我，我想報答你。聽了你們兩邊的說法，我覺得還是我去比較合適。要我把你的同伴帶回來嗎？

scripts.text: No. I just want you to ^0000cdfind them^000000 and make sure they're okay. If they need help, please provide it to them. If they have a message for me, then please let me know.
scripts.translation: 不，我只想讓你找到他們，確認他們平安無事。如果他們需要幫助，就幫幫他們；如果他們有話要帶給我，也請轉告。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I wish I could go with you, but my group needs me here.
scripts.translation: 真希望能和你同去，可我的小隊需要我留在這裡。

scripts.text: I can't trust her with the notebook. If something happens to it, the people inside it might not be able to come back.
scripts.translation: 我不能把筆記交給她。萬一筆記出事，裡面的人可能就回不來了。

scripts.text: This does it! Father Grimm, put that book down. Let's fight!
scripts.translation: 夠了！格林神父，把書放下，我們打一架！

scripts.text: Then I'm going to go with the Adventurer!
scripts.translation: 那我就跟冒險者一起去！

scripts.text: No. You're staying with me. Don't you dare touch the book.
scripts.translation: 不行，你得留在我身邊。別想碰那本書。

scripts.text: Why are you doing this to me? What have I done to you?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要這麼對我？我到底做錯了什麼？

scripts.text: Brother Jojo asked me to never let you touch the book. Do you not remember that?
scripts.translation: 喬喬兄弟交代過，絕不能讓你碰這本書。你不記得了嗎？

scripts.text: No, I don't remember. When Sister Gem returns, I'm going to tell on you!
scripts.translation: 不記得！等傑姆修女回來，我就告你的狀！

scripts.text: Now, Adventurer. Let me know when you're ready.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，準備好後告訴我。

scripts.text: Do you want to enter the notebook? Are you ready?
scripts.translation: 你想進入筆記本嗎？準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Not a problem. Just let me know when you are ready.
scripts.translation: 沒問題，準備好了再告訴我。

scripts.text: I placed my hand on the notebook, and Father Grimm opened it to the last page. Suddenly, my vision got blurry as I felt my body being transported to some place.
scripts.translation: 我把手放在筆記本上，格林神父翻開最後一頁。突然視線模糊起來，我感覺身體被傳送到了某個地方。

scripts.text: Listen to me, or you can always go back to the Tower.
scripts.translation: 聽我說，你也可以隨時回中央塔。

scripts.text: Ah, there you are! How was that place?
scripts.translation: 啊，你回來了！那地方怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I'm glad you came back safely. Is everyone in there okay?
scripts.translation: 你平安回來就好。裡面的人都沒事吧？

scripts.text: I relayed what happened in the notebook to Father Grimm and Mojo, and told them that the others decided to stay to keep an eye on the vampires.
scripts.translation: 我把筆記本里的見聞告訴了格林神父和莫喬，也說其他人決定留下來監視吸血鬼。

scripts.text: Wow, the same place in another plane of existence! I've never heard of this before! How does it work? This notebook has got to have something to do with it.
scripts.translation: 哇，竟然是另一個位面的同一地點！我從沒聽說過這種事！它究竟是怎麼運作的？肯定和這本筆記有關。

scripts.text: And vampires who understand humans? My goodness!
scripts.translation: 而且吸血鬼竟然聽得懂人話？天哪！

scripts.text: I can't stay here. Father Grimm, I have to go in there. Let me go, please!
scripts.translation: 我不能繼續待在這裡。格林神父，我得進去！求你讓我去吧！

scripts.text: No. Never. Keep your hands to yourself.
scripts.translation: 不行，絕對不行。把手放好，別亂碰。

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for venturing into that mysterious place for us. It'll be greatly appreciated if you visit my colleagues there and bring news from them to me sometimes.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，謝謝你替我們探查那個神秘之地。如果你能時常去看看我的同伴，再把他們的訊息帶回來，我會非常感激。

scripts.text: I can do that too, you know. You just have to give me a chance!
scripts.translation: 我也能做到啊！給我個機會就行！

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you. Feel free to come to me if you want to ^0000cdenter the notebook again^000000.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，謝謝你。想要再次進入筆記本，隨時來找我。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, do you want to enter the notebook?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你想進入筆記本嗎？

scripts.text: Not a problem. Just let me know when you are ready.
scripts.translation: 沒問題，準備好了再告訴我。

scripts.text: I see. Just let me know when you want to leave.
scripts.translation: 知道了。想離開時再告訴我。

scripts.text: So, you're in a hurry to leave. Did something happen?
scripts.translation: 這麼急著離開？發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text: Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?
scripts.translation: 你確定拿得動這麼多東西嗎？清一清背包吧。

scripts.text: Sister Gem, please listen to me!
I'm worried about those two. They should be fine, right?
scripts.translation: 我很擔心那兩個人。他們應該沒事吧？

scripts.text: Have you found Jojo? Where is he? Jubilee has left to treat his wounds.
scripts.translation: 你找到喬喬了嗎？他在哪兒？朱比利已經去給他治傷了。

scripts.text: This place has so many things I want to study, I don't know where to begin. Oh my, look at that Nightmare!
scripts.translation: 這裡有這麼多值得研究的東西，我都不知道該從哪兒開始。天啊，快看那隻夢魘！

scripts.text: Adventurer, I don't want you to strain yourself. Why don't you go get some rest?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，別太勉強自己。不如先去休息一下？

scripts.text: Have a good night's sleep, and come back after dawn.
scripts.translation: 好好睡一覺，天亮後再回來。

scripts.text: Adventurer. Did you have good dreams last night? I had nightmares, probably from looking at those manes all day.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，昨晚睡得好嗎？我做了噩夢，大概是因為整天盯著那些鬃毛看吧。

scripts.text: But I'm not about to give up!
scripts.translation: 但我不會就此放棄！照常幫我

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000cd20 Wavy Manes^000000 as usual.
Oh, and it'll be great if you also can get rid of ^0000cd10 Sweet Nightmares^000000. I want to know how that'll affect dreams. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 哦，順便幫我解決10只甜夢魘吧。我想知道這會如何影響夢境。謝謝！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, can I talk to you for a second? I want your opinion on something.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，能佔用你一點時間嗎？我想聽聽你的看法。

scripts.text: Oh, are you? No problem. I can wait until you have some time for me.
scripts.translation: 這樣啊，沒關係。等你有空再來找我吧。

scripts.text: You've seen those Nightmares and Drainliars, right? Did you notice how they look different from the kinds outside this place? Why do you think that is?
scripts.translation: 你見過夢魘和紅蝙蝠吧？有沒有注意到它們和外面的同類長得不一樣？你覺得這是為什麼？

scripts.text: Everything in this place is interesting. Especially those Sweet Nightmares. They're full of contradictions.
scripts.translation: 這裡的一切都很有意思，尤其是那些甜夢魘。它們身上充滿矛盾。

scripts.text: Have you taken a look at their wavy mane? Look at it long enough, and you'll see flashes of images, which I believe are from other people's dreams.
scripts.translation: 你仔細看過它們搖曳的鬃毛嗎？盯久了會看到閃爍的影像，我覺得那是別人的夢境。

scripts.text: Sweet Nightmares... Even their name is a contradiction. Maybe their mane is the source of all nightmares.
scripts.translation: 甜夢魘......連名字都自相矛盾。也許它們的鬃毛就是所有噩夢的源頭。

scripts.text: Or it could just reflect the dreams of the dead.
scripts.translation: 也可能只是映照出死者的夢。

scripts.text: Those two ladies may not agree, but I don't have to stay here. I'm only staying because of ^0000cdSweet Nightmares^000000.
scripts.translation: 那兩位女士也許不認同，不過我沒必要留在這裡。我留下來只是為了研究甜夢魘。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I want to get rid of their manes and see if it affects our dreams.
scripts.translation: 我想收集它們的鬃毛，看看是否會影響我們的夢境。

scripts.text: And I want to do that without having to leave my colleagues to fend for themselves. Do you know what I mean?
scripts.translation: 我也不想把同伴丟在這裡，讓他們獨自面對危險。你明白我的意思嗎？

scripts.text: Do you want me to ^0000cdget their manes for you^000000?
scripts.translation: 你要我幫你收集它們的鬃毛嗎？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And while you're at it, please hunt ^0000cd10 Sweet Nightmares^000000 as well. I want to know how that affects dreams.
scripts.translation: 順便再獵殺10只甜夢魘吧。我想知道這會怎樣影響夢境。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Thank you. In return, I'll give you some stones I've picked up from this place.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你。我把在這裡撿到的幾塊石頭送給你，算是答謝。

scripts.text: I don't know if they have any purpose, but they sure look beautiful and mysterious. Maybe someone outside this place can recognize its value.
scripts.translation: 我不知道它們有什麼用途，不過看起來既漂亮又神秘。也許外面的人能認出它們的價值。

scripts.text: Anyway, thank you for doing this for me!
Adventurer, I've been waiting for you! Did you get what I asked?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，我等你好久了！要的東西拿到了嗎？

scripts.text: You brought all of them. I hope I can find something out from them.
scripts.translation: 你全都帶來了。希望能從中發現些線索。

scripts.text: These are found only inside this place. Please bring them to me whenever you can. Dreams disappear when you wake up, you know.
scripts.translation: 這些東西只有這裡才有。以後有機會就帶些給我吧。畢竟夢境一醒就會消失。

scripts.text: Thank you so much. You should get some rest now.
scripts.translation: 太感謝你了。你也去休息一下吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I've been waiting for you! Did you get what I asked?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，我等你好久了！要的東西拿到了嗎？

scripts.text: Um, you haven't found it, I see.
Please bring me ^0000cd20 Wavy Manes^000000 from ^0000cdSweet Nightmares^000000.
scripts.translation: 請從甜夢魘身上收集20根搖曳鬃毛帶給我。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, and it'll be great if you also can get rid of ^0000cd10 Sweet Nightmares^000000. I want to know how that'll affect dreams. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 哦，順便幫我解決10只甜夢魘吧。我想知道這會如何影響夢境。謝謝！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?
scripts.translation: 你確定拿得動這麼多東西嗎？清一清背包吧。

scripts.text: Brother Antoine, you stay here. Sister Marina and I will go. Do either of you have a problem with that?
scripts.translation: 安托萬兄弟，你留在這裡。我和瑪麗娜去找。你們有意見嗎？

scripts.text: Brother Antoine and I will go. We're trained to fight. You are not.
scripts.translation: 我和安托萬兄弟去。我們受過戰鬥訓練，你沒有。

scripts.text: Marina, why don't you stay? Sister Gem and I will go. I think that'd be best, considering our abilities.
scripts.translation: 瑪麗娜，你留下吧。我和傑姆修女去。按我們的能力這樣安排最好。

scripts.text: No. This place is overrun with unholy creatures. It's better if two servants of God look for them.
scripts.translation: 不行，這裡到處都是邪惡生物。由兩位神的僕人去找更合適。

scripts.text: What's that supposed to mean? Are you saying that I can't fight zombies because I'm not a servant of God?
scripts.translation: 這話是什麼意思？你是說我不是神的僕人，所以就打不過腐屍嗎？

scripts.text: How about two of us stay and one goes?
scripts.translation: 不如兩個人留下，一個人去？

scripts.text: No. It has to be two, so they can look out for each other.
scripts.translation: 不行，必須兩個人一起去，才能互相照應。

scripts.text: What about the person left behind? They have no one to look out for them.
scripts.translation: 那留下的那個人怎麼辦？他可沒人照應。

scripts.text: Excuse me. I came here on behalf of Father Grimm.
scripts.translation: 打擾了，我是受格林神父所託來的。

scripts.text: Did you come to help us?
He's worried that you haven't come out. He asked me to help you if you need it. Did something happen?
scripts.translation: 他擔心你們遲遲沒出來，讓我來看看是否需要幫忙。發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: We need to find some people.
You can't just tell him that. Adventurer, you know what kind of place this is, don't you? We're in a hurry, so let me explain the situation to you quickly.
scripts.translation: 你不能就這麼告訴他。冒險者，你知道這裡是什麼地方吧？我們時間緊，我儘快跟你說明情況。

scripts.text: This place is the spitting image of the Geffen catacombs, and it probably exists inside the notebook's owner's memory.
scripts.translation: 這裡和吉芬地下墓穴一模一樣，很可能存在於筆記本主人的記憶中。

scripts.text: We came here to find out how and why this place was created.
scripts.translation: 我們來這裡是想弄清這個地方是如何形成的，以及形成的原因。

scripts.text: We didn't find anything peculiar about this place. We want to leave, but a couple of us, ^0000cda priest and a wizard^000000 hasn't returned to join us.
scripts.translation: 我們沒發現什麼特別之處。本想離開，但有兩個人——e一位牧師和一位巫師——還沒回來。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We've searched around, but the notebook's owner's memory of this place is rather hazy and inconsistent. Illusions of different wizards keep appearing, frequently and in masses.
scripts.translation: 我們四處找過，但筆記本主人對這裡的記憶模糊又混亂。不同巫師的幻影不斷出現，而且數量很多。

scripts.text: We thought it'd take forever to find them, so we decided to split up. We were discussing how we'd go about doing it when you showed up.
scripts.translation: 我們覺得這樣找下去不知要耗多久，於是決定分頭行動。你來的時候，我們正在商量怎麼分組。

scripts.text: I can't say how glad I am to have you here. Now that there are four of us, ^0000cdtwo of us can stay while the other two look^000000.
scripts.translation: 你來了真是太好了。現在有四個人，可以兩人留下，另外兩人去找人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What do the missing members look like?
The missing priest is called ^0000cdJubilee^000000 and the wizard is ^0000cdJojo^000000. They're the typical priest and wizard. You won't miss them.
scripts.translation: 失蹤的牧師叫朱比利，巫師叫喬喬。都是典型的牧師和巫師，不會認錯的。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Let me pray for you before you leave. Dear God, please watch over your children...
scripts.translation: 出發前讓我為你祈禱。親愛的主啊，請守護您的孩子......

scripts.text: I hope Brother Jubilee and Brother Jojo are safe.
scripts.translation: 希望朱比利兄弟和喬喬兄弟都平安。

scripts.text: If you have to leave, let Sister Marina know. She'll send you back to where you came from.
scripts.translation: 要離開的話，告訴瑪麗娜修女。她會送你回原來的地方。

scripts.text: Brother Jubilee has left to treat his wounds, but Brother Jojo hasn't returned. I really hope he's safe.
scripts.translation: 朱比利兄弟去處理傷口了，但喬喬兄弟還沒回來。真希望他平安無事。

scripts.text: If you have to leave, let Sister Marina know. She'll send you back to where you came from.
scripts.translation: 要離開的話，告訴瑪麗娜修女。她會送你回原來的地方。

scripts.text: I really hope Brother Jojo is safe.
scripts.translation: 真希望喬喬兄弟平安無事。

scripts.text: If you have to leave, let Sister Marina know. She'll send you back to where you came from.
scripts.translation: 要離開的話，告訴瑪麗娜修女。她會送你回原來的地方。
冒險者，你現在要離開嗎？

scripts.text: Father Grimm must be getting anxious by now.
scripts.translation: 格林神父現在一定很著急了。

scripts.text: Yes. Now that I know you're safe, it's time I return to Father Grimm.
scripts.translation: 是的。既然知道你們平安無事，我該回去找格林神父了。

scripts.text: According to our assessment, what happens inside this place doesn't seem to ^0000cdaffect^000000 the outside world.
scripts.translation: 根據我們的判斷，這裡的情況似乎不會影響外面的世界。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That's good, but someone still has to stay here to keep an eye on them. You understand us, right? Please let Brother Grimm know.
scripts.translation: 這倒是好訊息，但還是得有人留下來盯著他們。你能理解吧？請轉告格林神父。

scripts.text: You're from the Church. I didn't think you'd let those vampires live.
scripts.translation: 你們是教會的人，我還以為不會讓那些吸血鬼活著。

scripts.text: If we play by the rules, then we shouldn't allow them to live.
scripts.translation: 按規矩來說，我們確實不該放過他們。

scripts.text: She's right. We shouldn't. But looking at them... I wasn't sure if they deserved to die.
scripts.translation: 她說得沒錯。但看著他們......我也不確定他們是否罪該致死。

scripts.text: It's something we need to think about.
But if they make even the slightest mistake, we'll get rid of them!
scripts.translation: 不過他們只要稍有差池，我們就會除掉他們！

scripts.text: If that happens, I'll let you take care of them by yourself.
scripts.translation: 真到了那時候，我就把他們全交給你一個人處理。

scripts.text: Please tell Brother Grimm that we've decided to stay to keep an eye on them.
scripts.translation: 請告訴格林神父，我們決定留下來監視他們。

scripts.text: Please tell Brother Grimm that we've decided to stay
scripts.translation: 請告訴格林神父，我們決定留下來。

scripts.text: If you want to leave, ask Sister Marina to let you out.
scripts.translation: 想離開的話，找瑪麗娜修女送你出去。

scripts.text: Adventurer, not enough time has passed since you hunted last time. You need rest.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，距離你上次狩獵還沒多久，該休息一下了。
明天請在黎明之後再來。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: As usual, I'd like you to exterminate ^0000cdRestless Deads^000000. There are ^0000cdthree different kinds: Small, Fast, and Big. Please exterminate 10 each.^000000.
scripts.translation: 照舊，請消滅躁動的亡靈。它們有小型、迅捷型和大型三種，每種都請消滅10只。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Even if you are busy, please spare me a moment of your time.
scripts.translation: 就算你很忙，也請抽點時間聽我說幾句。

scripts.text: Okay, then I'll wait until you have some time for me.
scripts.translation: 好吧，等你有空再來找我。

scripts.text: As you know, we're here to keep an eye on them.
scripts.translation: 你知道的，我們留在這裡是為了監視他們。

scripts.text: Now, that's interfering with our original mission, which is to keep this place clear of the unholy.
scripts.translation: 可這和我們原本的任務衝突了——清除這裡的邪惡生物。

scripts.text: We've been trying to do both, and it's hard to do that between just the three of us.
scripts.translation: 我們三個人一直想兩邊兼顧，實在有些力不從心。

scripts.text: The dead belong in the ground. We are here to ^0000cdput the undead back to eternal sleep^000000.
scripts.translation: 死者理應長眠。我們來這裡就是為了讓亡靈重歸永眠。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What kinds of monsters do you want me to take care of?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我處理哪些魔物？

scripts.text: Please exterminate ^0000cdRestless Dead^000000. There are ^0000cdthree different kinds: Small, Fast, and Big. Please exterminate 10 each.^000000.
scripts.translation: 請消滅躁動的亡靈。它們有小型、迅捷型和大型三種，每種都請消滅10只。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Got it. I was thinking, now that I'm  here, I might as well help you while I can. I'm glad that I can. I'll be back.
scripts.translation: 明白了。既然來了，我也想盡量幫上忙。能幫到你們真好，我會再回來的。

scripts.text: Adventurer, did you take care of what I asked?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，我交代的事辦妥了嗎？

scripts.text: Or did you forget what I asked you to do?
scripts.translation: 還是說，你忘了我交代的事？

scripts.text: Please exterminate ^0000cdRestless Deads^000000. There are ^0000cdthree different kinds: Small, Fast, and Big. Please exterminate 10 each.^000000.
scripts.translation: 請消滅躁動的亡靈。它們有小型、迅捷型和大型三種，每種都請消滅10只。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: All the dead must return to the earth.
scripts.translation: 所有死者都應歸於塵土。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you took care of them all. Thank you. They will also thank you from Heaven.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你把它們全都解決了。謝謝你，它們在天堂也會感謝你的。

scripts.text: Why don't you go get some rest and come back after dawn?
scripts.translation: 先去休息一下，天亮後再回來吧。

scripts.text: Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?
scripts.translation: 你確定拿得動這麼多東西嗎？清一清背包吧。

scripts.text: This one has a different color from Neon Mushrooms. Is it a new kind? I'd better pick it carefully...
scripts.translation: 這個和霓虹蘑菇顏色不同，是新品種嗎？我得小心採下來......

scripts.text: This one has a different color from Neon Mushrooms. Is it a new kind? I'd better pick it carefully...
scripts.translation: 這個和霓虹蘑菇顏色不同，是新品種嗎？我得小心採下來......

scripts.text: Jojo? You're Jojo, right? Your colleagues are worried about you. Let's go back. You're not hurt, are you?
scripts.translation: 喬喬？你就是喬喬吧？你的同伴都很擔心你。我們回去吧。你沒受傷吧？

scripts.text: I'm... My name is ^0000cdBomi^000000. I'm sorry I'm not the person you're looking for.
scripts.translation: 我......我叫波米。抱歉，我不是你要找的人。 ^0000cd^000000
波米？等等，你就是那個波米？

scripts.text: I didn't mean to be nosy. I had to know who it belonged to, so I could?
scripts.translation: 我不是故意打探你的事，只是想知道筆記本是誰的，這樣我才能......

scripts.text: Why did you throw it away? Why are you staying here?
scripts.translation: 為什麼要扔掉？你又為什麼留在這裡？

scripts.text: Because I'm a monster. I belong here.
scripts.translation: 因為我是魔物，我就該待在這裡。

scripts.text: Why do you think you're a monster?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼覺得自己是魔物？

scripts.text: What happened? You were a human.
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？你以前是人類啊。

scripts.text: I got betrayed by my best friend.
scripts.translation: 我被最好的朋友背叛了。

scripts.text: Most people try to make the most out of life because they know they can't live forever.
scripts.translation: 大多數人都努力過好一生，因為他們知道自己無法永生。

scripts.text: I was given a shorter time to live than most. Ever since I was born, I'd been told I'd never outlive my parents.
scripts.translation: 我能活的時間比大多數人都短。從出生起，大家就說我活不過父母。

scripts.text: People desire what they don't have. I desired ^0000cdstrength^000000 because I was too small and frail to live like others my age.
scripts.translation: 人總是渴望得不到的東西。我渴望力量，畢竟我太瘦弱，沒法像同齡人那樣生活。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I became a wizard because I thought magic could compensate for my physical weakness.
scripts.translation: 我以為魔法能彌補身體的弱點，所以成了巫師。

scripts.text: I didn't realize a strong mind comes from a strong body, though...
scripts.translation: 可我沒想到，強健的身體才能孕育堅強的心......

scripts.text: Magic was exhausting to both my mind and my body. I reached my limits more quickly than I thought. But I wasn't upset. I thought I could remedy that.
scripts.translation: 魔法對身心都是極大的負擔。我比想像中更快就到達極限，但我沒有氣餒，以為總能找到辦法。

scripts.text: Yes. Doing that, I felt more alive than ever. My burning desire for life made me who I was.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。那樣做讓我感到前所未有的鮮活。對生命的強烈渴望成就了當時的我。

scripts.text: Then, one day, while I was here, I met an ^0000cdentity^000000 who was not human.
scripts.translation: 後來有一天，我在這裡遇見了一個非人類的存在。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Bomi is gathering her thoughts. I should talk to her later.
scripts.translation: 波米正在整理思緒。晚些時候再來找她吧。

scripts.text: So he ^0000cdpromised^000000. Then one day, some people came here looking for him, and they fought.
scripts.translation: 於是他答應了。後來有一天，有人來這裡找他，雙方打了起來。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And the next thing I knew, I was turned. Dracula broke his promise.
scripts.translation: 等我回過神來，自己已經變成了吸血鬼。德古拉食言了。

scripts.text: I couldn't believe he turned me into a monster. I trusted him!
scripts.translation: 我不敢相信他竟把我變成魔物。我那麼信任他！

scripts.text: People in the outside world must think I skipped town. How long has it been since I left?
scripts.translation: 外面的人肯定以為我離開了這裡。我到底離開多久了？

scripts.text: Sigh, maybe they all forgot about me, as if I never existed. That's what pains me the most.
scripts.translation: 唉，也許大家都把我忘了，就像我從未存在過一樣。這才是最讓我難受的。

scripts.text: I try to ignore my reality, but this ever-present hunger and thirst keep reminding me what kind of terrible monster I am.
scripts.translation: 我試著不去想自己的處境，可揮之不去的飢餓和口渴總提醒我，我已經成了多麼可怕的魔物。

scripts.text: If I go back to the outside world, I won't be able to stop myself from hurting people.
scripts.translation: 如果回到外面的世界，我一定會忍不住傷害別人。

scripts.text: How did you sustain yourself so far?
scripts.translation: 你一直是怎麼活下來的？

scripts.text: I studied ^0000cdpharmaceutical formulation^000000 to make up for my weak stamina with potions.
scripts.translation: 我研究了藥劑調配，用藥水彌補體力不足。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I drink fake blood that I make with the ingredients I can find here. I may look ^0000cdhuman enough^000000, but I'm not. Not really.
scripts.translation: 我用這裡找到的材料調變假血來喝。我看起來或許和人類很像，實際上卻不是。真的不是。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I'm sorry I bored you with my story.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，讓你聽了這麼無聊的故事。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I don't want to impose on your kindness, but may I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，我不想辜負你的好意，但能請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text: You shouldn't say that. What if I ask for your blood?
scripts.translation: 別這麼說。萬一我開口要你的血呢？

scripts.text: I was joking. I'm in the middle of collecting the fake blood ingredients, but right now I want to examine this mushroom. I've never seen it before. I want to check it while it's still fresh.
scripts.translation: 開玩笑的。我正在收集調變假血的材料，不過現在想先研究這朵蘑菇。我從沒見過這種，想趁它新鮮時檢查一下。

scripts.text: What kinds of ingredients do you need? I'll get them for you.
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼材料？我幫你找來。

scripts.text: Thank you. I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you for doing this for me.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。我需要10份啞光紅蝙蝠的黏稠血液和10份霓虹蘑菇汁液。麻煩你了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Here, I brought the things you asked.
Thank you. I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you for doing this for me.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。我需要10份啞光紅蝙蝠的黏稠血液和10份霓虹蘑菇汁液。麻煩你了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It turned out to be an ordinary, invaluable mushroom.
scripts.translation: 結果只是種普通蘑菇，沒什麼特別價值。

scripts.text: How do you make artificial blood?
Matte Drainliars feed on the blood of the reanimated corpses in this place.
scripts.translation: 這裡的啞光紅蝙蝠以復活的屍體為食，吸食它們的血。

scripts.text: Did you get it? But their blood is highly toxic. So I use these mushrooms to detoxify it.
scripts.translation: 明白了嗎？不過它們的血毒性很強，所以我用這些蘑菇來解毒。

scripts.text: But even their sap cannot completely remove the toxins in the blood. And when I ingest too much toxins...
scripts.translation: 但只靠蘑菇汁液還不能完全去除血液裡的毒素。要是攝入太多毒素......

scripts.text: Maybe you should've chosen a different career path.
scripts.translation: 也許你當初該選別的職業。

scripts.text: I didn't know I was talented at this. If I had ^0000cdenough time to live^000000, I would've had many different experiences. I might have chosen a different path.
scripts.translation: 我以前不知道自己有這方面的天賦。要是我有足夠長的人生，或許能體驗許多不同的事，也可能會選擇另一條路。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, by the way, weren't you looking for someone? What did you say his name was? Juju?
scripts.translation: 對了，你不是在找人嗎？他叫什麼來著？朱朱？

scripts.text: I haven't seen any other humans around here, but if I do, I'll let him know you're looking for him.
scripts.translation: 我沒在附近見過其他人類。不過要是遇見他，我會告訴他你在找他。

scripts.text: I hope you'll find him soon. I'm not the only one here, you know. If you haven't found him, maybe he's?
scripts.translation: 希望你能儘快找到他。這裡可不只我一個人。你還沒找到他的話，說不定他......

scripts.text: Never mind. Good luck finding him. Maybe you should check the catacombs in the south.
scripts.translation: 算了，祝你好運。也許該去南邊的地下墓穴找找。

scripts.text: I hope you'll find your friend soon. Why don't you check the catacombs in the south? He might be there.
scripts.translation: 希望你能早點找到朋友。去南邊的地下墓穴看看吧，他可能在那裡。

scripts.text: Stay away from me, and I won't hurt you.
scripts.translation: 離我遠點，我就不會傷害你。

scripts.text: One of us is missing. You hurt him, didn't you?
scripts.translation: 我們少了一個人。是你傷了他，對吧？

scripts.text: I've never hurt anyone, and I won't start now.
scripts.translation: 我從沒傷害過任何人，以後也不會。

scripts.text: Even if you won't, we're not going to let you go! Your existence in itself goes against His will!
scripts.translation: 就算你不想傷人，我們也不會放你走！你的存在本身就違背了祂的旨意！

scripts.text: His will? God loves us all. Isn't that what you preach?
scripts.translation: 祂的旨意？你們不是總說上帝愛世人嗎？

scripts.text: The dead belong in the ground, and you're one of them. What do you think you are?
scripts.translation: 死者就該歸於塵土，而你也是死者。你以為自己是什麼？

scripts.text: ...But... But I really didn't hurt anyone.
scripts.translation: 可......可是我真的沒傷害過任何人。

scripts.text: That doesn't guarantee you won't in the future.
scripts.translation: 這不代表你以後不會傷人。
等等，瑪麗娜修女，冷靜一點。

scripts.text: Why aren't we getting rid of her already? The dead shall return to the earth! Brother Antoine!
scripts.translation: 為什麼還不除掉她？死者就該歸於塵土！安托萬兄弟，動手！

scripts.text: Argh, I can't believe you threw yourself in the middle of that! This is why I can't leave you alone!
scripts.translation: 啊，真不敢相信你竟然衝進他們中間！難怪我不能把你一個人丟下！

scripts.text: There's another vampire! No wonder why this place felt so off it's filled with vampires!
scripts.translation: 還有一個吸血鬼！難怪這裡一直透著古怪，原來到處都是吸血鬼！

scripts.text: Human, did you just call me a bat? How dare you?
scripts.translation: 人類，你剛才叫我蝙蝠？你好大的膽子！

scripts.text: Wait, Sister Marina. I said, calm yourself.
scripts.translation: 等等，瑪麗娜修女，我說了，冷靜。

scripts.text: We have to act now. We've already incapacitated one out of the three.
scripts.translation: 我們必須立刻動手。三個人裡已經有一個被我們制服了。

scripts.text: But one of them doesn't want to fight. She wants to talk.
scripts.translation: 可其中一個不想打，她想談談。

scripts.text: Who wants to talk? Because I don't! I'm not going to go down without a fight!
scripts.translation: 誰想談？我可不想！我絕不會束手就擒！

scripts.text: Grr, let me go! Enough is enough!
Oh geez, how do you move so fast?
scripts.translation: 天啊，你怎麼動作這麼快？
喬喬兄弟！你沒事真是太好了！

scripts.text: Where were you? We couldn't find you, and we looked everywhere!
scripts.translation: 你剛才去哪兒了？我們到處找你，怎麼也找不到！

scripts.text: It's true. His wounds are almost fully healed.
scripts.translation: 是真的，他的傷幾乎已經痊癒了。

scripts.text: Don't touch Bomi... She... I... We don't want to hurt anyone... She's taught me that...
scripts.translation: 別碰波米......她......我......我們不想傷害任何人......是她教會我的......

scripts.text: Dracula! Dracula! Let me heal you!
scripts.translation: 德古拉！德古拉！讓我來治好你！

scripts.text: I'm not going to let you do that!
Leave them be. They saved Jojo.
scripts.translation: 讓他們去吧，是他們救了喬喬。

scripts.text: But they could be using him as bait!
scripts.translation: 可他們可能是拿他當誘餌！

scripts.text: Even if they try to attack us, there are more of us than them.
scripts.translation: 就算他們想襲擊我們，我們人數也更多。

scripts.text: I agree with Sister Gem. Also, it's not an everyday opportunity that we can see vampires from this close.
scripts.translation: 我贊成傑姆修女的看法。而且，能這麼近距離觀察吸血鬼，可不常有。

scripts.text: You're Bomi, right? I read your notebook. What happened? What did these vampires do to you?
scripts.translation: 你是波米吧？我讀過你的筆記本。發生了什麼？這些吸血鬼對你做了什麼？

scripts.text: I relayed Bomi and Dracula's story to Nun Gem and the others.
scripts.translation: 我把波米和德古拉的遭遇告訴了傑姆修女等人。

scripts.text: So you're saying they really are innocent.
scripts.translation: 所以你的意思是，他們確實無辜？

scripts.text: Whose blood is that? You can't let him drink that!
scripts.translation: 那是誰的血？不能讓他喝那個！

scripts.text: It's not real blood! He needs it! Can't you see he's dying?
scripts.translation: 那不是真血！他需要這個！你看不出來他快不行了嗎？

scripts.text: Gosh, you're so stubborn. Feed him. I'll keep them at bay.
scripts.translation: 天啊，你可真固執。喂他吧，我來擋住他們。

scripts.text: You're letting her feed him, that vampire? Sister Gem, have you forgotten your duty as our leader?
scripts.translation: 你竟然讓她喂那個吸血鬼？傑姆修女，你忘了自己身為領袖的職責嗎？

scripts.text: Marina, I don't care who they are. They saved me and asked for nothing in return.
scripts.translation: 瑪麗娜，我不在乎他們是什麼。他們救了我，也沒要求任何回報。

scripts.text: I didn't understand why vampires would help humans, but now I know. Dracula learned from Bomi how to be more human.
scripts.translation: 我以前不明白吸血鬼為什麼會幫人類，現在知道了。德古拉從波米身上學會了如何更像人。

scripts.text: He said he wanted to understand humans, so he could better understand her. And I think he's achieved his goal.
scripts.translation: 他說想了解人類，這樣才能更理解她。我覺得他已經做到了。

scripts.text: He helped me and expected nothing in return. Such a random act of kindness is a human trait, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 他幫了我，卻什麼也沒要求。這種不求回報地幫助別人，不正是人類的特質嗎？

scripts.text: And you shouldn't help someone because of who they are. Marina, are you really going to let him die because he's not one of us?
scripts.translation: 而且，不該因為對方的身份就決定幫不幫忙。瑪麗娜，你真要因為他不是我們的人，就眼睜睜看他死嗎？

scripts.text: That only applies to us humans. They're vampires!
scripts.translation: 那隻適用於人類！他們可是吸血鬼！

scripts.text: Now I understand why Dracula was so distrustful of you humans. I thought he was being too picky.
scripts.translation: 現在我明白德古拉為什麼不信任人類了。我還以為是他太挑剔。

scripts.text: Hey, you monk, over there. What do you think makes you human? What do you think makes a vampire a vampire? What if there's a vampire that's never hurt anyone in their life?
scripts.translation: 喂，那邊的武僧。你覺得是什麼讓你成為人類？又是什麼讓吸血鬼成為吸血鬼？如果有個吸血鬼一生都沒傷害過任何人呢？

scripts.text: What if there's a human who did nothing but hurt others. What would you do about them?
scripts.translation: 那如果有人類一輩子只會傷害別人，你又會怎麼做？

scripts.text: I'll let justice decide their fate.
scripts.translation: 我會讓正義決定他們的下場。

scripts.text: When I hunt, I treated all humans equally because I'm a vampire. That's my rule.
scripts.translation: 我狩獵時一視同仁地對待所有人類，因為我是吸血鬼。這就是我的原則。

scripts.text: Their rule is to help anyone who needs help regardless of who they are. Simple, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 他們的原則是，不論對方是誰，只要需要幫助就伸出援手。很簡單，不是嗎？

scripts.text: Did you... save me? I thought you wanted me to die.
scripts.translation: 是你......救了我？我還以為你巴不得我死。

scripts.text: No, and now I understand why you made that decision. You couldn't just let me die, could you?
scripts.translation: 不。現在我明白你當初為什麼那麼做了。你終究沒法眼睜睜看著我死，對吧？

scripts.text: Because I couldn't do it, either.
Brothers. Sisters. We need to talk.
I'm sorry I broke my promise. But even if I could go back in time, I would do it again.
scripts.translation: 對不起，我違背了約定。但就算能回到過去，我還是會那麼做。

scripts.text: I understand now why you did that.
scripts.translation: 我現在明白你為什麼那麼做了。

scripts.text: Did you guys make up? Dracula, the worst is over. You just need to rest and regain your energy.
scripts.translation: 你們和好了？德古拉，最危險的時候已經過去。你現在只需要休息，恢復體力。

scripts.text: *Snort* You can't beat mushrooms, but you can save vampires.
scripts.translation: *哼*你們打不過蘑菇，卻能救吸血鬼。

scripts.text: Drac, let's go. I know you're not hurting anymore. We should really go back to our castle this time.
scripts.translation: 德古拉，我們走吧。我知道你已經不疼了。這次真的該回城堡了。

scripts.text: What? No! You've made up with her. It's time to leave!
scripts.translation: 什麼？不行！你們都和好了，該走了！

scripts.text: We know you haven't hurt anyone, and you want to keep it that way. And we appreciate you saved Brother Jojo.
scripts.translation: 我們知道你沒傷害過任何人，也不想傷害任何人。感謝你救了喬喬兄弟。

scripts.text: But that doesn't change the fact that your existence in itself defies our god's will. We can't leave you alone.
scripts.translation: 但你的存在本身仍違揹我們所信奉的神的旨意，我們不能放任不管。

scripts.text: Drac, they won't leave us alone. Let's just get rid of them!
scripts.translation: 德古拉，他們不會放過我們。乾脆把他們都解決掉！

scripts.text: Sister Gem, this is just a waste of time. They're going to kill us the first chance they get. Let's get rid of of them before they do!
scripts.translation: 傑姆修女，這純粹是在浪費時間。他們一有機會就會殺了我們，趁他們動手前先除掉他們！

scripts.text: Sisters, let me talk. Your tendency to jump to conclusions is not helping this situation.
scripts.translation: 兩位修女，讓我來說。你們急著下結論，只會讓事情更難處理。

scripts.text: We understand you don't want to hurt anyone.
scripts.translation: 我們明白你們不想傷害任何人。

scripts.text: But you're dangerous to others, whether you like it or not.
scripts.translation: 但無論你們願不願意，你們確實會對其他人構成威脅。

scripts.text: Why are you looking at me? I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation: 你們看我幹嘛？我什麼也沒做！

scripts.text: Now that we know you exist, we can't ignore you. I can, but these people here can't. Their church won't allow it.
scripts.translation: 既然知道你們的存在，我們就不能當作沒看見。我可以不管，但這裡的人不行，他們的教會不會允許。

scripts.text: We're not going to make any decision. Instead, we'll ^0000cdstay here with you^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們不會立刻做出任何決定，而是會留下來陪著你們。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: So you can keep an eye on us. Drac, I can't take this anymore!
scripts.translation: 所以你們要留下來監視我們？德古拉，我受夠了！

scripts.text: What? Drac! Stop acting like a human! We're proud, dignified vampires!
scripts.translation: 什麼？德古拉！別學人類那一套！我們可是高傲又有尊嚴的吸血鬼！

scripts.text: Let's go back. I'm tired. I want to sleep.
I'm not happy with this arrangement, Drac. I'm going back to our castle once you get better, got it?
scripts.translation: 德古拉，我可不喜歡這個安排。等你好了我就回城堡，聽見沒有？

scripts.text: So we've come to an agreement. We'll leave now.
scripts.translation: 那我們就說定了。我們先告辭。

scripts.text: You! I'm watching you! Better keep your coffin lid shut tight while you sleep!
scripts.translation: 你給我等著！我會盯著你！睡覺時最好把棺材蓋蓋嚴實！

scripts.text: I should leave too. Excuse me.
Argh! I don't ever want to see them again! Let's go!
scripts.translation: 啊！我再也不想見到他們了！走吧！

scripts.text: Bomi, I'll see you when I get better.
scripts.translation: 波米，等我康復了再來看你。

scripts.text: Finally, they all left. That was close.
scripts.translation: 他們總算都走了，真是有驚無險。

scripts.text: Thank you, Adventurer. Everything went well, and no one got hurt because of you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你，冒險者。多虧了你，一切順利，也沒人受傷。

scripts.text: You asked me if you looked like a human. Remember?
scripts.translation: 你還記得你問過我，看起來像不像人類嗎？

scripts.text: What do you think defines a human?
I didn't know you when you were a human, but I don't think you were different from who you are now. You're still trying to protect what's important to you.
scripts.translation: 我沒見過你還是人類時的樣子，但我覺得你和現在沒什麼不同。你依然努力保護著自己珍視的人。

scripts.text: I think you're more human than anyone else I know. You also taught a vampire humanity.
scripts.translation: 我覺得你比我認識的任何人都更有人性。你甚至教會了吸血鬼什麼是人性。

scripts.text: ...Thank you. I never imagined someone would say such kind words to me one day, but I've longed to hear them.
scripts.translation: ......謝謝你。我從沒想過有一天會有人對我說這樣的話，可我一直都盼著聽到。

scripts.text: I couldn't get over the fact that I became a monster, but now I know better. I may not be a human anymore, but I'm still me.
scripts.translation: 我一直無法接受自己變成了魔物，但現在我明白了。我或許不再是人類，卻依舊是我自己。

scripts.text: I should go. It's time I report back.
scripts.translation: 我該走了，得回去彙報了。

scripts.text: Okay. Travel safely. And thank you for your help.
scripts.translation: 好，路上小心。也謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text: Didn't you say you have to report back? Go to the exit. I smelled your friends there.
scripts.translation: 你不是說要回去彙報嗎？去出口吧，我聞到你的同伴就在那邊。

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for trying to help me, but I don't want you to strain yourself. Why don't you rest for now?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，謝謝你願意幫我，但別太勉強自己，先休息一會兒吧。

scripts.text: You can come back after dawn.
I'm away right now. Please come back after dawn.
scripts.translation: 我現在不在，請天亮後再來。

scripts.text: Adventurer, welcome back. Could you help me today as usual?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，歡迎回來。今天也能像往常一樣幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Bomi is away. She has left a note.
I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. You can get them if you hunt at least ^0000cd5 Matte Drainliars and 5 Neon Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要10份啞光紅蝙蝠的黏稠血液和10份霓虹蘑菇汁液。至少獵殺5只啞光紅蝙蝠和5只霓虹蘑菇，就能收集到這些材料。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, did you report already? Do you have something else to do here?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你已經彙報過了嗎？還要在這裡辦別的事嗎？

scripts.text: If you're not busy, could you help me with something?
scripts.translation: 如果你不忙，能幫我一件事嗎？

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy at the moment.
Oh, are you? I'm sorry. Maybe you could come back later? no, never mind.
scripts.translation: 這樣啊，抱歉。要不你晚點再來？......算了。

scripts.text: As you know, I live on that fake blood that I make with the ingredients I find around here. I'm thinking I'll make some more for Dracula as well.
scripts.translation: 你知道，我靠用附近找到的材料調變假血為生。我想再做些給德古拉喝。

scripts.text: But since this fake blood is not pure, drinking it regularly causes your body to accumulate toxins, which drive you insane until they are completely purged from your system.
scripts.translation: 不過這種假血並不純，長期飲用會讓毒素在體內累積。毒素排淨之前，人會因此變得神志不清。

scripts.text: But maybe that only happens to me. I'm a new vampire, and I'm weak. Dracula has lived for a long time, and he's anything but weak.
scripts.translation: 也許只有我會這樣。我是個新生的吸血鬼，身體又弱。德古拉活了很久，強得很。

scripts.text: Anyway, I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation: 總之，我需要10份啞光紅蝙蝠的黏稠血液和10份霓虹蘑菇汁液。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can find them if you hunt at least ^0000cd5 Matte Drainliars and 5 Neon Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation: 至少獵殺5只啞光紅蝙蝠和5只霓虹蘑菇，就能找到這些材料。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Bomi is away. I'll just leave these here.
scripts.translation: 波米不在，我先把東西放在這裡吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer, did you forget what I asked? I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你忘了我讓你帶的東西嗎？我需要10份啞光紅蝙蝠的黏稠血液和10份霓虹蘑菇汁液。謝謝。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Bomi is away. I'll just leave these here.
scripts.translation: 波米不在，我先把東西放在這裡吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer, did you forget what I asked? I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你忘了我讓你帶的東西嗎？我需要10份啞光紅蝙蝠的黏稠血液和10份霓虹蘑菇汁液。謝謝。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Bomi is away. I'll just leave these here.
scripts.translation: 波米不在，我先把東西放在這裡吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for bringing these to me.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，謝謝你把這些材料帶來。

scripts.text: By the way, I told you about the dangers of this fake blood. Remember? It leaves toxins in my system.
scripts.translation: 對了，還記得我說過這種假血有危險嗎？它會讓毒素留在體內。

scripts.text: Right now, there are so many toxins in my body that I can feel like I'm turning into a monster.
scripts.translation: 我現在體內的毒素太多，感覺自己快要變成魔物了。

scripts.text: I can't wait it out like I used to.
scripts.translation: 我不能像以前那樣硬撐過去

scripts.text: Not when there are people to worry about.
scripts.translation: 了。現在還有人讓我牽掛。

scripts.text: When I turn into a monster, I want you to stop me from hurting them. Please, help me.
scripts.translation: 如果我變成魔物，求你阻止我傷害他們。幫幫我。

scripts.text: Then please come back after dawn.
I ran out of the ingredients I had.
scripts.translation: 我把手頭的材料都用完了。

scripts.text: If I mix them like this and drink...
scripts.translation: 如果我這樣混合再喝下去......

scripts.text: Oh, no! There is too many toxins in my body. It's getting dangerous!
scripts.translation: 糟了！我體內的毒素太多，情況越來越危險了！

scripts.text: If I drink this toxic blood about thirty times, I might turn? oh, never mind.
scripts.translation: 如果再喝三十次這種毒血，我可能就會變成......算了。

scripts.text: Then please come back after dawn.
Hey, why are you carrying so much? Go lighten your bag first.
scripts.translation: 喂，你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？先去清理一下背包。

scripts.text: What, do you have business with me? If not, shoo!
scripts.translation: 怎麼，有事找我？沒事就走開！

scripts.text: You can't be smelling me. I'm not bleeding anymore. I already healed!
scripts.translation: 你不可能聞到我的血。我已經不流血了，傷也治好了！

scripts.text: No. It's from somewhere else, and I'm smelling more than one human. ...A ^0000cdfight^000000! A fight broke out somewhere! Blood! Let's go!
scripts.translation: 不是你的血，是從別處傳來的，而且不止一個人......有地方打起來了！有血腥味！走！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: A fight? ...No. What if the people from the Church found Bomi?
scripts.translation: 有人打起來了？......糟了，萬一教會的人找到波米怎麼辦？

scripts.text: *Sniff* This way! The smell is coming from this way!
*Sniff* This way! The smell is coming from this way!
Why are you looking at me like that? Dracula needs more rest. Do not disturb him.
scripts.translation: 你為什麼這麼看著我？德古拉還需要休息，別打擾他。
冒險者，你這麼快就回來了。

scripts.text: Yes, why did you come back so quickly? I don't want to be disturbed right now. Come back later.
scripts.translation: 怎麼這麼快又回來了？我現在不想被打擾，晚點再來。

scripts.text: Why are you so excited to see me?
You'll take care of those Matte Drainliars like you did the last time, right? They're too loud.
scripts.translation: 你會像上次一樣收拾那些啞光紅蝙蝠吧？它們吵死了。

scripts.text: And you'll get some ^0000cdShort Bat Hairs^000000 too, right? I need a lot more than what you brought last time.
scripts.translation: 也會幫我帶些短蝙蝠毛回來吧？上次那些遠遠不夠。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Ah, Adventurer. Good to see you again! Dracula is doing better, though he sleeps all day.
scripts.translation: 啊，冒險者，很高興又見到你！德古拉好多了，不過整天都在睡。

scripts.text: He's fully recovered, but he still doesn't want to leave. I don't know why he's so infatuated with that turned human.
scripts.translation: 他已經完全康復了，卻還是不肯離開。我不懂他為什麼這麼迷戀那個變成吸血鬼的人類。

scripts.text: Oh, do you mean Bomi? I thought she was a vampire like Dracula.
scripts.translation: 哦，你是說波米？我還以為她和德古拉一樣是吸血鬼。

scripts.text: Not all vampires are the same. We're different from her. By the way, why are you still here? Dracula doesn't need you anymore.
scripts.translation: 吸血鬼也有不同種類，我們和她不一樣。對了，你怎麼還在這兒？德古拉已經不需要你幫忙了。

scripts.text: Well, there are things around here that I want to study, and...
scripts.translation: 嗯，這裡還有些東西我想研究，而且......

scripts.text: Do you have a death wish? Haven't you noticed how hungry and ferocious these bats are? They latch onto anything that moves, these creeps! Take care of them for me, will you?
scripts.translation: 你是嫌命長嗎？沒發現這些蝙蝠又餓又兇？它們會撲向所有會動的東西，真是一群討厭鬼！幫我收拾一下，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Oh, are you? Then go. Go away.
King, you don't have to be so mean.
scripts.translation: 國王，你沒必要這麼刻薄。

scripts.text: He was mean to me first! And he said he's busy. That's why I said go. Go!
scripts.translation: 明明是他先對我沒禮貌！他說自己忙，我才叫他走的。快走！

scripts.text: Well, they don't bother me as long as I stay close to Dracula and King.
scripts.translation: 只要待在德古拉和國王身邊，它們就不會來煩我。

scripts.text: But they drink zombie blood! Yuk! I'll never drink dead blood, no matter how hungry I am. That's disgraceful!
scripts.translation: 可它們居然喝腐屍的血！噁心！我再餓也不會喝死人的血，太丟人了！

scripts.text: So you're hating your own kind.
scripts.translation: 所以你是在嫌棄自己的同類啊。

scripts.text: In case you have forgotten, do you know how you're still standing there, breathing?
scripts.translation: 你是不是忘了，自己為什麼還能好端端地站在這兒呼吸？

scripts.text: Because I let you. And I'm letting you breathe not because you're worth living, but because I'm too lazy to kill you.
scripts.translation: 因為我准許你活著。我留你一命可不是覺得你值得活，只是懶得殺你。

scripts.text: ...Oh. Thank you for everything. Um, I think it's time I should rejoin my group.
scripts.translation: ......哦。謝謝你一直以來的照顧。嗯，我想該回隊伍那邊了。

scripts.text: I'm still talking to you. You're not afraid of me because I'm in bat form, are you? You humans are so stupid, you can't get past what you see.
scripts.translation: 我還沒說完呢。你不會因為我變成蝙蝠就不怕我吧？你們人類真蠢，只看表面。

scripts.text: I agree that these bats are disgraceful, shameless, and disgusting animals.
scripts.translation: 這些蝙蝠真是無恥又噁心的動物。

scripts.text: Did you just call me a disgusting animal?
scripts.translation: 你剛才是在說我是噁心的動物嗎？

scripts.text: No, no. Not you. I'm talking about Matte Drainliars.
scripts.translation: 不不，不是說你。我說的是啞光紅蝙蝠。

scripts.text: I have a question for you, King.
Why are you in bat form?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼變成蝙蝠的樣子？

scripts.text: Yes. If you hate them so much, then why don't you go back to your original form?
scripts.translation: 沒錯。既然你這麼討厭它們，為什麼不變回原來的樣子？

scripts.text: That's because this form is more efficient. I don't have to drink a lot to get full, I'm inconspicuous, and people, like that numskull over there, let their guard down around me.
scripts.translation: 因為這樣更方便。我不用喝很多就能吃飽，身形也不顯眼，而且像那邊那個笨蛋一樣的人還會對我放鬆警惕。

scripts.text: I'm not a numskull. I wouldn't have become a wizard if I was. And don't forget, I saved Dracula!
scripts.translation: 我才不是笨蛋！要是笨蛋，我能當上巫師嗎？別忘了，德古拉還是我救的！

scripts.text: But why a bat? There are other small animals.
scripts.translation: 可是為什麼偏偏是蝙蝠？還有別的小動物啊。

scripts.text: Because bats are stealthy, and they can fly. Oh, speaking of which, did you know the short hair of Matte Drainliars is used for making cloaking capes?
scripts.translation: 因為蝙蝠行動隱蔽，還會飛。對了，你知道啞光紅蝙蝠的短毛能做隱身斗篷嗎？

scripts.text: Huh? No, I've never heard that.
Cloaking capes? Thieves and their ilk must love those.
scripts.translation: 隱身斗篷？盜賊和那些傢伙肯定最喜歡了。

scripts.text: I can't believe how simple-minded you are.
scripts.translation: 真沒想到你這麼沒腦子。

scripts.text: Erm, how can I get the hair? By hunting Matte Drainliars?
scripts.translation: 呃，那要怎麼弄到蝙蝠毛？獵殺啞光紅蝙蝠嗎？

scripts.text: Why, do you want to quit magic and turn to thievery?
scripts.translation: 怎麼，你想放棄魔法，改行當盜賊？

scripts.text: No. But it's always been my dream to conquer all the dungeons on the continent and become the greatest mage.
scripts.translation: 不是。我一直夢想著征服大陸上所有的地下城，成為最偉大的魔法師。

scripts.text: ...That's a big dream, an impossible dream. Well, anyone can dream big.
scripts.translation: ......真是個宏大又不切實際的夢想。不過，誰都可以做大夢。

scripts.text: Even if it's not for my dream, a cloaking cape will come in handy in various situations.
scripts.translation: 就算不為夢想，隱身斗篷在很多時候也能派上用場。

scripts.text: I didn't know there was an aspiring thief among us. Huh.
scripts.translation: 沒想到我們當中還藏著個準盜賊。呵。

scripts.text: I said that's not what I want. Adventurer, are you busy?
scripts.translation: 我都說了不是想當盜賊。冒險者，你現在有空嗎？

scripts.text: What, you're going to ask him? Do it yourself!
scripts.translation: 什麼，你還要問他？自己去做啊！

scripts.text: I have other things to do.
Like what? Eating, sleeping, and pooping?
Oh, come on! You know I've been busy studying things!
scripts.translation: 拜託！你知道我一直忙著研究東西！

scripts.text: You mean, studying me and Dracula.
I've known that from the beginning. Your face is so transparent, you can't hide anything. I just didn't say anything because I found it funny that you nervously kept glancing at us.
scripts.translation: 我一早就知道了。你的表情藏不住秘密。我只是覺得有趣，才一直沒說，看你緊張地偷瞄我們。

scripts.text: ...Oh. Then can I ask you questions?
scripts.translation: ......這樣啊。那我可以問你一些問題嗎？

scripts.text: Adventurer, are you going to get the bat hair for him? Good, that means you'll take care of those Matte Drainliars. Their flapping their wings keep me awake at night.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你會幫他拿蝙蝠毛吧？很好，那你也會收拾那些啞光紅蝙蝠了。它們整晚撲騰翅膀，吵得我睡不著。

scripts.text: Why can't you do it yourself? All you have to do is just flick your finger.
scripts.translation: 你為什麼不自己去？不就動動手指的事嗎？

scripts.text: I can flick my finger at you if you want.
scripts.translation: 你想的話，我可以彈你一下。

scripts.text: Adventurer, please bring me the bat hair. King, I mean, Mr. King, how much bat hair do I need?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，請幫我帶些蝙蝠毛來。國王，我是說，國王陛下，要多少才夠？

scripts.text: That depends on what kind of cape you want. Just know that it's tough to make stuff with hair.
scripts.translation: 看你想做什麼樣的斗篷。反正用毛髮做東西可不容易。

scripts.text: Um, okay, then please bring me ^0000cd20 Short Bat Hairs^000000 for starters.
scripts.translation: 嗯，好吧，那先幫我帶20根短蝙蝠毛。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: While you're at it, hunt the ^0000cdMatte Drainliars^000000 around us. There are at least ^0000cd10^000000.
scripts.translation: 順便把我們周圍的啞光紅蝙蝠也獵殺了，至少要10只。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You came back quickly. I hope you didn't forget anything.
scripts.translation: 你回來得真快，希望沒忘記什麼。

scripts.text: Wizard! The adventurer has brought the hair.
scripts.translation: 巫師！冒險者把蝙蝠毛帶回來了。

scripts.text: What am I supposed to do now?
That's for you to figure out. I'm not a cape maker, am I? But I know you would need more than that.
scripts.translation: 你自己想辦法吧。我又不是斗篷師傅。不過我知道這點材料肯定不夠。

scripts.text: He just came back from hunting. You should let him rest, at least for the rest of the day.
scripts.translation: 他剛狩獵回來，至少今天剩下的時間讓他休息吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer, come back tomorrow and hunt more Matte Drainliars for me, will you? It's so quiet without them.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，明天再回來幫我獵殺些啞光紅蝙蝠，好嗎？沒有它們可真安靜。

scripts.text: You came back quickly. I hope you didn't forget anything.
scripts.translation: 你回來得真快，希望沒忘記什麼。

scripts.text: Look what we've got here. Did you forget what I asked? I told you to ^0000cdhunt 10 Matte Drainliars and bring 20 Short Bat Hairs^000000.
scripts.translation: 看看你，忘了我交代什麼了嗎？我讓你獵殺10只啞光紅蝙蝠，再帶回20根短蝙蝠毛。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?
scripts.translation: 你確定拿得動這麼多東西嗎？清一清背包吧。

scripts.text: Aww, my wounds are fully healed, but I'm still in pain.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，傷是完全好了，可還是覺得疼。

scripts.text: How's Mojo doing? Heh, she's so curious, I feel sorry for Brother Grimm for having to deal with her.
scripts.translation: 莫喬怎麼樣了？呵呵，她好奇心太重了，格林兄弟真夠受的。

scripts.text: I can't leave here just yet. There are still many things in this place I want to know about.
scripts.translation: 我暫時還不能離開。這裡還有很多事情值得了解。

scripts.text: King has smelled blood. Even though that's how he found me when I was bleeding to death, it still scares me that he can do that.
scripts.translation: 國王聞到了血腥味。上次我血流不止時，他就是靠這個找到我的。不過知道他能聞出來，還是讓我有點害怕。

scripts.text: A fight has broken out somewhere over there. Don't you want to go check?
scripts.translation: 那邊好像發生了打鬥，你不想過去看看嗎？

scripts.text: I'm going to stay here for a while. It'll take for a while before Dracula fully regains his energy, and personally, there are many things that I want to know about these people.
scripts.translation: 我還會在這裡待一陣子。德古拉恢復元氣還要些時間，而且我也有很多關於這些人的事想了解。

scripts.text: Please let Nun Gem and Mojo know.
scripts.translation: 請把訊息告訴傑姆修女和莫喬。

scripts.text: Adventurer, see this luminous glow over here? It's from the shining spores you brought to me.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，看那邊的微光了嗎？那是你帶來的發光孢子散發出來的。

scripts.text: I feel as if I traveled back in time, studying by this dim light.
scripts.translation: 藉著這微弱的光學習，讓我彷彿回到了過去。

scripts.text: I still have enough light left in these shining spores. Please come back after dawn.
scripts.translation: 發光孢子還夠照一陣子。天亮後再來吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer! You are the light of my life!
scripts.translation: 冒險者！你就是我的生命之光！

scripts.text: Could you get me shining spores again today?
scripts.translation: 今天能再幫我找些發光孢子嗎？

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 請從霓虹蘑菇身上收集10份發光孢子，另外從甜夢魘身上收集10簇夢魘鬃毛。謝謝！ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Where? Oh, I did it again.
Tsk, tsk. I don't know how you've become a wizard when you can't even spell correctly.
scripts.translation: 嘖嘖，連字都拼不對，你到底怎麼當上巫師的？

scripts.text: This is only because it's too dark to see. And stop peeking at what I'm doing!
scripts.translation: 這裡太暗了，我看不清嘛。還有，別偷看我在寫什麼！

scripts.text: It's not like you're writing something important.
scripts.translation: 反正你寫的也不是什麼重要東西。

scripts.text: You two get along as well as I remember.
scripts.translation: 你們倆還是和我記憶中一樣合得來。

scripts.text: What are you doing here? Don't you have things to do?
scripts.translation: 你在這兒做什麼？不用忙別的事嗎？

scripts.text: Are you? I was going to ask you a favor, but I can wait.
scripts.translation: 是嗎？我本來想請你幫個忙，不過可以等你有空再說。

scripts.text: Then you'd better go attend to your business.
scripts.translation: 那你還是先去忙自己的事吧。

scripts.text: Since we're underground, it's too dark for me to write and read. I have a lot of information that I want to catalog, but I keep misspelling words because I can't see them clearly.
scripts.translation: 我們身在地下，光線太暗，沒法讀寫。我有很多資料想整理，可看不清楚，老是把字寫錯。

scripts.text: You should be able to do that with your eyes closed. You're a wizard. Didn't you learn how to summon light? But of course, if you use magic in front of me, I'll burn you to ashes.
scripts.translation: 你可是巫師，閉著眼睛也該做得到吧？沒學過照明術嗎？當然，你要敢在我面前用魔法，我就把你燒成灰。

scripts.text: I completed my guild's official wizard training program. I'm strong enough to have a contest with you!
scripts.translation: 我完成了公會的正式巫師訓練，實力足以和你一較高下！

scripts.text: Be honest, though. Did you really study hard? Did you attend every class, study all night, and practice hard? You'd better tell me the truth.
scripts.translation: 不過說實話，你真有那麼用功嗎？每堂課都去上了，整夜苦讀，還勤加練習？給我說實話。

scripts.text: Can you honestly say that you tried to push past your limits?
scripts.translation: 你能問心無愧地說，自己確實突破過極限嗎？

scripts.text: No, you didn't. That's why you had your butt handed to you by those mushrooms.
scripts.translation: 沒有吧。所以你才會被那些蘑菇打得落花流水。

scripts.text: I said they were zombies, not mushrooms!
scripts.translation: 我說的是腐屍，不是蘑菇！

scripts.text: Zombies and mushrooms. Same difference to me.
scripts.translation: 在我看來，腐屍和蘑菇沒什麼區別。

scripts.text: You're not good enough to earn your keep. I can't believe your guild actually invested in you.
scripts.translation: 你連養活自己都不夠格。我真不敢相信公會竟然在你身上投入資源。

scripts.text: Then what about you? I know you can transform. But what else can you do?
scripts.translation: 那你呢？我知道你會變身，除此之外還會什麼？

scripts.text: Maybe you keep questioning me because you can't trust me. How about I teach you to be the greatest mage among humans? Would you trust me, then?
scripts.translation: 你一直追問我，也許是因為不信任我。要是我教你成為人類中最偉大的魔法師，你會信我嗎？

scripts.text: Erm, you want to teach me?
I've studied a lot. Why do you think I have?
scripts.translation: 我讀過很多書。你覺得我為什麼這麼做？

scripts.text: No. Because I was bored to death!
You have all the time in the world. I'm envious of that.
scripts.translation: 你有的是時間，真讓人羨慕。

scripts.text: If you don't want me to teach you, that's fine by me.
scripts.translation: 你不想讓我教，那也隨你。

scripts.text: No, no! I'd love to! But, erm, you're not going to ask for my blood in return, are you?
scripts.translation: 不不，我當然願意！不過，呃......你不會要我的血當報酬吧？

scripts.text: *Snort* If I drink anything because I'm hungry, I wouldn't be any better than those Matte Drainliars now, would I?
scripts.translation: *哼*我若是餓了就隨便吸血，豈不是和那些啞光紅蝙蝠沒兩樣？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to keep you standing there. Could you get me some spores from Neon Mushrooms? I need some light to see what I'm writing.
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉，讓你站了這麼久。能幫我從霓虹蘑菇身上弄些發光孢子嗎？我需要照明，才能看清自己寫的東西。

scripts.text: Oh, you know how those spores glow. I want to use them to illuminate this place.
scripts.translation: 你知道那些孢子會發光吧？我想用它們照亮這裡。

scripts.text: Well, then go get them yourself. Don't dump things on this adventurer.
scripts.translation: 那就自己去拿，別把事情都推給冒險者。

scripts.text: Oh, well... I'm... Neon Mushrooms are... You know.
Where are you going to put the spores, anyway?
scripts.translation: 話說回來，你打算把孢子放在哪裡？

scripts.text: I have an empty bottle? oh, I forgot I lost my bag when I was attacked.
scripts.translation: 我有個空瓶......啊，想起來了，我遇襲時把包弄丟了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, could you get me some Clusters of Nightmares as well? I can mix them with the spores to make a paste and apply it on the wall.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，也幫我找些甜夢魘鬃毛吧。我可以把它們和孢子混成糊狀，塗在牆上。

scripts.text: But effective nonetheless. You didn't know you could use them like that, did you?
scripts.translation: 但確實管用。你不知道它們還能這麼用吧？

scripts.text: Then, Adventurer, please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares.
scripts.translation: 那麼，冒險者，請從霓虹蘑菇身上收集10份發光孢子，另從甜夢魘身上收集10簇夢魘鬃毛。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I can tell that's not enough, just by looking at it.
scripts.translation: 光看一眼就知道這點東西不夠。

scripts.text: Oh, you're right. You must have forgotten what I asked.
scripts.translation: 哦，你說得對。你肯定忘了我拜託你的事。

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 請從霓虹蘑菇身上收集10份發光孢子，另從甜夢魘身上收集10簇夢魘鬃毛。拜託了。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I can tell he brought everything you asked. Come on, make a paste and apply it to the wall already.
scripts.translation: 看得出來他把你要的東西都帶來了。快調好漿糊，塗到牆上吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for helping me study. These glowing spores don't last long. Could you come back tomorrow and get me more of them?
