scripts.translation: 冒險者，謝謝你幫我研究。這些發光孢子撐不了多久，明天能再幫我找一些嗎？

scripts.text: This orb needs more time to gather enough energy before it'll work.
scripts.translation: 這顆寶珠還需要些時間聚集能量，之後才能使用。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou must be level 120 or higher to enter this area.^000000
scripts.translation: 進入此區域需要達到120級。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000I feel dazed, as if I'm dreaming.^000000
scripts.translation: 我一陣恍惚，感覺自己像是在做夢。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我攜帶的物品種類太多了，得先清一下背包。

scripts.text: I have all the twigs I need. I should go back to Zeith and Vrid.
scripts.translation: 樹枝已經收集夠了，該回去找澤伊特和弗裡德了。

scripts.text: I checked the mound of dirt to look for twigs.
scripts.translation: 我檢查了一下土堆，看看能不能找到樹枝。

scripts.text: There's nothing inside this mound of dirt.
scripts.translation: 這個土堆裡什麼也沒有。

scripts.text: Um.. Are you an adventurer?? I have a favor to ask you...
scripts.translation: 呃......你是冒險者嗎？我有件事想拜託你......

scripts.text: ...Oh, you need more experience. Excuse me.
scripts.translation: ......哦，你還需要積累些經驗。抱歉

scripts.text: - ^0000CDLevel 150 and over can do this quest.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 等級達到150級以上才能接取此任務。 - ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I am from the Alberta Guard of the 1st Knights Division, Knight Aylvar.
scripts.translation: 我是第一騎士團艾爾貝塔衛隊的騎士艾爾瓦。

scripts.text: Under the command of the Knights, I am on a mission to search for Alberta's 2nd Knights Division, who had disappeared in Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 我奉騎士團之命，前來搜尋在海龜島失蹤的艾爾貝塔第二騎士團。途中遭遇猛烈

scripts.text: However, after meeting a violent storm, I arrived at a Turtle Island, but it didn't seem like the normal Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 風暴，醒來時我已身在一座海龜島上，但那裡似乎並非平常的海龜島。

scripts.text: I was in danger, but someone helped me out.
scripts.translation: 我當時身陷險境，幸好有人救了我。

scripts.text: As I woke up, I felt the sea breeze from Alberta's harbor... In my hands, two pieces of this turtle shell.
scripts.translation: 醒來時，我感受到艾爾貝塔港口吹來的海風......手裡還握著兩塊這樣的龜殼碎片。

scripts.text: Here is only one piece I have right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在只剩一塊。另一塊

scripts.text: My friend might have the other one. No, I mean he must still have.
scripts.translation: 也許在我朋友手裡。不，我相信他一定還拿著。
你的朋友遇到危險了嗎？

scripts.text: I understand. Even for me, I am bewildered, but please hear me out. I think my friend is in danger
scripts.translation: 我明白。連我自己都覺得不可思議，但請聽我說完。我覺得朋友現在有危險。

scripts.text: Yes, it's about my friend. Sorry for such a long story, just a little more, hear me out.
scripts.translation: 是關於我朋友的事。抱歉說了這麼久，再聽我多說幾句。

scripts.text: I show these pieces to my friend, ^0000CDLeiphen^000000.
scripts.translation: 我把這些碎片給朋友萊芬 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: He shows big interest. ^0000CDHe said that it was made from the shell of a turtle living only on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 0000看。他非常感興趣，說這是生活在海龜島的一種海龜的龜殼製成的。 ^0000CD

scripts.text: After I handed the pieces to him....
My friend Leiphen who was looking at the pieces suddenly disappeared.
scripts.translation: ....正在檢視碎片的萊芬突然消失了。

scripts.text: In the meantime, I contacted Juno University and went to Turtle Island, but I haven't achieved any results... I was hoping I could find a clue so I figure out where Leiphen disappeared to.
scripts.translation: 00000發生的事。這期間我聯絡了朱諾大學，也去了海龜島調查，卻毫無進展......我希望能找到線索，查明萊芬消失去了哪裡。

scripts.text: {0}, please help us. Can you help me find my friend?
scripts.translation: ，請幫幫我們。能幫我找到朋友嗎？ {0}

scripts.text: This piece might be a clue. Please take a look.
scripts.translation: 這塊龜殼碎片或許能提供線索，請看看。

scripts.text: Please tell me your friend looks like.
^0000CDHe wears glasses^000000 and has blue short hair. ^0000CDHis face is just like a scholar^000000 so you should be able to recognize him.
scripts.translation: 他戴著眼鏡，留著藍色短髮。看起來像個學者，應該很好認。 ^0000CD^000000^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Show me the piece. Let me take a look.
I am sorry, {0}. You already have too much stuff. I figure it's difficult to find my friend right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，。你身上東西太多了，恐怕沒法馬上去找我朋友。 {0}

scripts.text: Can you clear up your inventory a little bit? I will be right here waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 能清理一下物品欄嗎？我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: - ^424242I grabbed the piece handed over by the knight. A small leaf is carved on the turtle shell. It's a bulky piece, but somehow feels warm.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我接過騎士遞來的碎片。龜殼上刻著一片小葉子。碎片雖然沉重，卻不知為何透著暖意。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242I was looking at the piece for a while, but suddenly something seemed to appear in my head. Suddenly a gust blows and my vision gets darker.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我盯著碎片看了一會兒，腦海中突然浮現出什麼。緊接著一陣風吹來，視線也逐漸暗了下去。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242EAylvar's voice is getting smaller and I felt dizzy. It's starting to smell like wet clay....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 艾爾瓦的聲音漸漸遠去，我感到一陣眩暈，空氣中開始瀰漫溼泥土的氣味...... - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: {0}! Oh, you are ok! I am... worried. After Leiphen, {1}, you also disappeared, I was really concerned.
scripts.translation: ！太好了，你沒事！我......一直很擔心。萊芬失蹤後，你也消失了，我急壞了。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: Are you going back to find Leiphen again?
If I can go there, I will save him myself.
scripts.translation: 是我能去那裡，我一定會親自救他。

scripts.text: Thank you. Thank you so much.
- ^424242As the girl who was there told me, I squeezed the piece of the turtle shell, I felt the wind blowing my hair again.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 和那個女孩說的一樣，我握緊龜殼碎片，又感到風拂過髮梢。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242Before my eyes were completely dark, my cheeks felt the cooler air from the cave....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 視線徹底變黑前，臉頰感受到洞穴裡吹來的涼風...... - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: Hi {0}. I have heard every story from Leiphen.
scripts.translation: 你好，。我已經聽萊芬講完 {0}

scripts.text: I am worried because he went there again. He said he would come back after finds out the secret of that place.
scripts.translation: 了他的經歷。他又去了那裡，我很擔心。他說查明那個地方的秘密就會回來。

scripts.text: Not only Leiphen but also a kid named Narin... who you also helped. You are a great adventurer.
scripts.translation: 不只是萊芬，還有你幫過的那個叫娜琳的孩子......你真是了不起的冒險者

scripts.text: Oh, since you are going there again, please make sure Leiphen is ok as well.
scripts.translation: 哦，既然你又要去，麻煩確認萊芬是否平安。

scripts.text: On the way, please make sure Leiphen is doing good.
scripts.translation: 來。路上請留意萊芬的情況。

scripts.text: Glad to see you again. I have reported the information to the Knights Division and now my job is to support Leiphen's research.
scripts.translation: 很高興再次見到你。我已向騎士團報告情況，現在負責協助萊芬研究。你

scripts.text: When I heard his story, I wanted to go there too... but I can't do as he explained. I am so sad.
scripts.translation: 聽完他的經歷，我也想去那裡看看......可我做不到他描述的那些事，真遺憾。

scripts.text: If you find Leiphen, please make sure he is eating.
scripts.translation: 如果找到萊芬，請確認他有好好吃飯。

scripts.text: - ^424242Beyond the door, it appears black, and nothing seems to exist. A reddish glow is floating in front of the black sky. A nervous looking girl appears.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 門後是一片漆黑，彷彿空無一物。黑色天空前浮著一道微紅的光，一個神情緊張的女孩出現了。 - ^424242^000000
這裡。絕望、無助，充滿毒性。

scripts.text: - ^424242It's a puzzling response, but it might help. As the girl told me, I held onto the turtle shell.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 她的回答令人費解，但或許能派上用場。我按女孩說的握緊了龜殼碎片。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242The smell of salty wind lifted the hem of my clothing. You can hear the waves of Alberta Harbor and the sound of seagulls....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 鹹鹹的海風掀起衣角。耳邊彷彿傳來艾爾貝塔港的浪濤聲和海鷗鳴叫...... - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242This red light is invisible to Narin. It just seems to disappear.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 娜琳看不見這道紅光，它似乎憑空消失了。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242If I don't come back, she will forget. Just right before I walk into the light, Narin's voice echoed from behind me.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 如果我不回去，她就會忘記。就在我踏入紅光前，娜琳的聲音從身後傳來。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: I will remember... Come back. Please. Bro...!
scripts.translation: 我會記住的......你一定要回來。求你了，哥哥......！

scripts.text: - ^424242Turning around with a small smile, Narin, holding her hands, was surprised and glanced over.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我微笑著轉過身。娜琳雙手緊握，驚訝地回頭望來。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242I nodded and recalled the bulky piece I had now kept by my heart. The sea breeze from the harbor blows by my ears...^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我點點頭，想起那塊沉重的龜殼一直貼在心口。港口的海風從耳邊拂過...... - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242Now I stand in front of the familiar light. Lightly waved my hand to Narin, she closed her eyes and held both hands together.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我站在熟悉的光芒前，輕輕向娜琳揮手。她閉上眼睛，雙手合十。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242With empty hands, I think of the bulky but warm piece left in my heart.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我空著雙手，心裡卻惦記著那塊沉重而溫暖的碎片。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242Turning around with a small smile, Narin, holding her hands, was surprised and glanced over.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我微笑著轉過身。娜琳雙手緊握，驚訝地回頭望來。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242I will come back again. I put my hands together on my chest.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 我會再回來的。我把雙手合在胸前。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242The consciousness became far away, and the salty, slightly fishy smell of Alberta Harbor tickled my nose.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 意識漸漸遠去，艾爾貝塔港鹹鹹的海風夾著些許魚腥味，輕輕拂過鼻尖。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: What are you doing with such a heavy bag? Clear some out.
scripts.translation: 你背這麼重的包做什麼？先清理一些吧。
生人。你又把那個東西帶來了。

scripts.text: You have a lot of questions, but no need to know.
scripts.translation: 你有很多問題，但沒必要知道答案。

scripts.text: But ^0000CDthere is someone here like you^000000. One who shouldn't be here.
scripts.translation: 不過這裡還有個人和你一樣——一個不該待在這裡的 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Go back with ^0000CDa scholar who has blue hair^000000. Do you know him?
scripts.translation: 人。跟那個藍髮學者一起回去。你認識他嗎？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: I am here to find him.

scripts.translation: 你認識考古學家萊芬嗎？

scripts.text: Good. I don't know his name and where he is, but I can guess.
scripts.translation: 很好。我不知道他的名字和下落，不過能猜到個大概。

scripts.text: ^0000CDThere are two locations^000000. Go find and take him. And do not come back.
scripts.translation: 0000CD有兩個地點。去找到他，把他帶走。以後別再回來。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Ok, but I have some questions.
Let me know the way to go back.
You will be gone for good. No need to know.
scripts.translation: 你會永遠消失。沒必要知道。

scripts.text: A spell that will protect you for a moment.
scripts.translation: 這是個能暫時保護你的咒語

scripts.text: It will follow you around. Curiosity killed the cat. Don't look into something that is unclear. Don't look back, or talk behind someone's back.
scripts.translation: 。它會一直跟著你。好奇心會害死貓。別去探究不明之事，也不要回頭，別在背後說人。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Don't be alarmed that you may breathe strangely.^000000
scripts.translation: 如果呼吸變得不正常，不要驚慌。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I don't know. I don't know where you came from, how could I know?
scripts.translation: 我不知道。我連你從哪兒來的都不知道，又怎麼會知道？

scripts.text: However, there, the empty door... might have something, you might know about.
scripts.translation: 不過那邊那扇空門......裡面或許有你想知道的東西。

scripts.text: - ^424242The girl glanced toward the back of where she was standing. Looking closely, it seems that something reddish is floating in front of the black hole. Let's go and look.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 女孩朝身後瞥了一眼。仔細看去，黑洞前似乎漂浮著一道紅色的光。過去看看吧。 - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: - ^424242The girl said briefly and stopped talking. She looks sad....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - 女孩只簡短地說了一句，便不再開口。她看起來很悲傷...... - ^424242^000000

scripts.text: Before you get in danger, get the person you were looking for and leave.
scripts.translation: 趁危險找上你之前，找到要找的人，然後離開。

scripts.text: You are safe. Both of you.
Then, go back. To the place you came.
scripts.translation: 那麼，回去吧，回到你來的地方。

scripts.text: Huh? What do you mean? I will come back again.
scripts.translation: 咦？你這是什麼意思？我還會再回來的

scripts.text: Until I find out all of the secrets here.
scripts.translation: 。直到揭開這裡所有的秘密為止。

scripts.text: Why do you ignore my warnings? Arrogant.
scripts.translation: 你為什麼無視我的警告？真傲

scripts.text: You may be a professor but that does not give you the right to walk around here.
scripts.translation: 慢。就算你是位智者，也不代表你有權在這裡隨意走動。

scripts.text: Please tell me. Where am I? What just happened here?
scripts.translation: 嗎？請告訴我。我這是在哪裡？剛才發生了什麼？

scripts.text: Stop? I didn't say anything wrong. You are going to leave and forget everything soon. You will never come back.... right?
scripts.translation: 別說？我又沒說錯。你很快就會離開，把一切都忘掉。你再也不會回來......對吧？

scripts.text: ......Fine. Arrogant or not. Think freely. I don't care anyway.
scripts.translation: ......隨你怎麼想吧，覺得我傲慢也好，不傲慢也罷。我才不在乎。

scripts.text: I said before.... but no one has returned. I am not expecting anyone to.
scripts.translation: 我之前說過......但從來沒人回來過。我也沒指望有人會回來。

scripts.text: ......No one comes back. It's better to not come here. It's full of danger.
scripts.translation: ......沒人會回來的。最好別來這裡，這裡到處都是危險。

scripts.text: You want that, but still someone is going to come back here.
scripts.translation: 你雖然希望如此，但還是會有人回來的。

scripts.text: Ok. Fine. Let me tell you. Promise me you will go back after listening. It's not like I want to talk a lot.
scripts.translation: 好吧。那我告訴你。答應我聽完就回去。我也沒打算說太多。

scripts.text: ...Give me a sec. I need time to think clearly. It's been a long time not talking....
scripts.translation: ......等我一下。我得理清思緒。已經很久沒和人說話了......

scripts.text: I'll talk to you again after a while.
It would be better to start introducing myself. I am Narin. ^0000CDOld Ghost.^000000
scripts.translation: .還是先自我介紹吧。我叫娜琳，是舊幽靈。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: You look like you have been through a lot of things before. I can see you are able to talk normally.
scripts.translation: 你看起來經歷過不少事，而且能正常和我交談。像你這樣

scripts.text: Ordinary people like a professor can't even see us.
scripts.translation: 普通的智者，甚至看不見我們。

scripts.text: All the residents here are spirits bound by the burden of resentment. When you're dead, obsessed with something you desperately want, and you'll always do the same thing without realizing it..
scripts.translation: 這裡的居民都是被怨念束縛的靈魂。人死後若對某件事懷有強烈執念，就會在無意識中不斷重複同一件事......

scripts.text: We hate life. Those who are not bound by the burden of resentment, those who breathe strangely. We want to hear your last breath.
scripts.translation: 我們憎恨活人。那些沒有被怨念束縛、呼吸方式古怪的人——我們想聽見他們嚥下最後一口氣。不過只

scripts.text: But unless you realize us, we cannot realize you either. It's a good thing.
scripts.translation: 要你察覺不到我們，我們也就無法察覺你。這反倒是好事。

scripts.text: It doesn't last long. The longer you stay here, the more you notice each other. Gradually.
scripts.translation: 這種狀態不會持續太久。你在這裡待得越久，彼此就越能漸漸察覺對方。然後

scripts.text: And suddenly you guys realize. That's strange. ...Then, it's over.
scripts.translation: 你們突然意識到不對勁......接著一切就結束了。

scripts.text: The professor got my stuff, so I could recognize it right away. Normally I wouldn't have known.
scripts.translation: 智者拿著我的東西，所以我立刻就認出來了。平常我根本不會知道。

scripts.text: It was you who saved Aylvar. Thank you for helping my friend!
scripts.translation: ....！原來是你救了艾爾瓦。謝謝你幫助我的朋友！

scripts.text: I wanted to do it.  My obsession is...
scripts.translation: 我只是想這麼做。我的執念是......

scripts.text: ^0000CDU I don't want anyone get die here. I want to save all life.^000000......
scripts.translation: 我不想讓任何人死在這裡。我想救下所有人。..... ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Oh... really, it's such a silly story. It's hard to keep talking.
scripts.translation: 哦......說出來真是個傻氣的故事。我已經說不下去

scripts.text: Just leave me alone for a while? Sorry for taking so long.
scripts.translation: 了。能讓我一個人待一會兒嗎？抱歉讓你等這麼久。

scripts.text: It's ok. I'll leave you for a moment. {0}, let's go together.
scripts.translation: 沒關係，我先讓她靜一靜。，我們一起走吧。 {0}

scripts.text: Thank you for waiting. I'm good now. Let me finish.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你等我。我好多了，讓我把話說完。

scripts.text: It's not the first time, someone is here. It's a rare event. When I first saw someone, I remembered what I wanted.
scripts.translation: 之前也有人來過這裡，不過很少見。第一次看到有人時，我想起了自己的願望。

scripts.text: The man was deathly afraid, but he was alive and left this place.
scripts.translation: 那個人怕得要命，但他活著離開了這裡。從那以後

scripts.text: After that... I could stay a little longer.
It's been a while, I haven't lost my mind. I was not swept away by resentment and neither reason nor emotion was lost.
scripts.translation: 過了這麼久，我還是沒有失去理智。我沒有被怨念吞噬，也沒有喪失理性或情感。

scripts.text: So I want to save all life. Those who have flowed in and even those trapped by the burden forever.
scripts.translation: 所以我想救下所有人——誤入這裡的人，還有永遠被怨念困住的靈魂。

scripts.text: I realized that all those I saved went back to where they came from.
scripts.translation: 我發現，被我救下的人最後都回到了原來的地方。

scripts.text: It's... it's hard. Even I envy those trapped by this burden. But... I couldn't turn it off. The people who are in danger.
scripts.translation: 這......真的很難。我甚至羨慕那些被怨念困住的人。可我沒法對身處險境的人袖手旁觀。......

scripts.text: I think it's better to just go.
scripts.translation: 我還是直接離開比較好。

scripts.text: Well, if the monster hunting is too cumbersome... you can carry me out..
scripts.translation: 要是覺得狩獵太麻煩......也可以直接把我帶出去......

scripts.text: Thank you for accepting. Well, I think it's better to think of these monsters as different ones from Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你答應幫忙。這裡的魔物和海龜島上的那些，最好當成不同種類看待。

scripts.text: In the meantime, I will make a fire.
Phew... I'm struggling all of a sudden. I'm an archaeologist, not a hero of an adventure story.
scripts.translation: ..突然覺得好吃力。我只是考古學家，可不是冒險故事裡的英雄。

scripts.text: Oops... The fire didn't go well. I can't burn books or tools.

scripts.translation: 真可惜，沒有能燒的東西......我生不起火。

scripts.text: That's really weird. You hunt living monsters, but somehow it only gives rotten meat?
scripts.translation: 真奇怪。你獵殺的是活魔物，怎麼拿到的肉卻是腐爛的？

scripts.text: I can't cook the rotten meat, but I can try to eat!
scripts.translation: 腐肉沒法煮，不過我可以試著生吃！

scripts.text: Ugh... I can't eat. Sorry... You tried for nothing...
scripts.translation: 呃......我吃不下。抱歉，讓你白忙一場......

Even if we can't talk, I can still figure something out by looking at people's lifestyle.

Uh, I didn't tell you. I'm taking a sabbatical year.

scripts.text: I've heard that they hire adventurers because they don't have enough hands to defend the village. I guess that's you?
scripts.translation: ！啊！我聽說村裡人手不夠守衛村莊，所以僱了冒險者。你就是他們僱來的人吧？

scripts.text: By the way, haven't I seen you somewhere? Your face looks strangely familiar.
scripts.translation: 對了，我是不是在哪兒見過你？你的臉看起來很眼熟。

scripts.text: Oops, I'm not in a position to compare similar faces... We're twins. Ha ha ha
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我可不該拿相似的臉來比較......我們是雙胞胎。哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Should I say hello? Nice to meet you. I'm Luanda, the defense manager of this cave.
scripts.translation: 先打個招呼吧。很高興認識你，我叫盧安達，負責管理洞窟防衛。

scripts.text: For simple quests, we have prepared a request board, so you can find them and report them to me.
scripts.translation: 簡單的委託都貼在公告欄上，你可以接取任務，再向我報告。

scripts.text: The quest itself doesn't have to be difficult, as you just have to go around the cave and deal with the monsters or bring the byproducts of the monsters.
scripts.translation: 任務不會太難，你只要在洞窟周邊巡查、處理魔物，或收集它們掉落的材料就行。

scripts.text: Since you've been hired by the village, I'd like you to work hard and lighten the burden a bit. It's really hard these days. Please.
scripts.translation: 既然村裡僱了你，就拜託你多出點力，幫忙減輕我們的負擔。最近實在太忙了，拜託了。

scripts.text: Then have a good time. Adventurer.
scripts.translation: 那祝你玩得開心，冒險者。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the strange shimmering you had witnessed.
scripts.translation: 我把看到的奇怪閃光告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: A strange shimmer? As you said, it's a really strange phenomenon.
scripts.translation: 奇怪的閃光？聽你這麼一說，確實挺反常的。

scripts.text: I've lived in the village for a long time, but it seems like a phenomenon I've never heard of. I'm guessing, but I think it's just started happening recently.
scripts.translation: 我在村裡住了很久，卻從沒聽說過這種現象。猜測一下，應該是最近才出現的。

scripts.text: I don't live alone in the village, and if someone had seen it, it would have been rumored, but hearing it for the first time would make my guess clear.
scripts.translation: 我不是獨自住在村裡。要是有人見過，早該傳開了。既然從沒聽說過，那就說明我的猜測沒錯。

scripts.text: It could be dangerous, so if you find it, why don't you avoid it? There's no need to take a risk.
scripts.translation: 這可能很危險。要是再遇到，就避開吧，沒必要冒險。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about three young men you met and talked to.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到並交談過的三個年輕男子告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: Uh.. huh?! You saw me and young men who look like like my brothers.
scripts.translation: 呃......什麼？！你見到我和幾個長得像我兄弟的年輕人了？

scripts.text: It seems like it happened a long time ago. Unlike Mao, I don't have a very good memory.
scripts.translation: 那應該是很久以前的事了。我記性可不像毛那麼好。

scripts.text: I vaguely remember it. I did warn a stranger I met before I went hunting with my brothers.
scripts.translation: 我隱約記得。以前我和兄弟們去打獵前，確實警告過一個陌生人。

scripts.text: It's not uncommon to see strangers in town, so my memory is hazy, but I remember it.
scripts.translation: 鎮上偶爾會有陌生人來，所以記憶有點模糊，不過我記得這件事。

scripts.text: It's interesting. If what you're saying is true, doesn't that mean you've been talking to me in the past?
scripts.translation: 真有意思。如果你說的是真的，那你以前就和我交談過了？

scripts.text: Ah! Come to think of it, do you remember the first time we met? Didn't I say I was used to being an adventurer?
scripts.translation: 啊！這麼說來，你還記得我們初次見面時，我說自己習慣了和冒險者打交道嗎？

scripts.text: As expected, I don't think it was a bad feeling. I really can't believe it. An adventurer who met me in the past...
scripts.translation: 果然，這種感覺不壞。我真不敢相信......你竟然是過去就見過我的冒險者......

scripts.text: That sounds like something similar could happen in the future, right?
scripts.translation: 聽起來未來也可能發生類似的事，對吧？

scripts.text: I apologize. Deep down, I felt that it was annoying for adventurers to talk to me. Now, I'll ask you first.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，其實以前我覺得冒險者來找我說話挺煩的。以後我會主動問你。

scripts.text: If you ever go through something similar, please let me know. I'm begging you.
scripts.translation: 下次要是再遇到類似的事，記得告訴我。拜託了。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told him about Karoo and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 我把卡魯和阿蘇德姆的事告訴了他。

scripts.text: Puhahaha I think you came to see the place where Hyung-nim and sister-in-law are dating.
scripts.translation: 噗哈哈，你是去看哥哥和嫂子約會的地方吧？

scripts.text: Oh my gosh.. that place is where my brother and sister-in-law often went on dates.
scripts.translation: 天哪......那地方確實是哥哥和嫂子常去約會的地方。

scripts.text: My brother might think it's a secret place only he knows, but it's a place everyone in the village knows.
scripts.translation: 哥哥可能以為那是隻有他知道的秘密地點，其實村裡人人都知道。

scripts.text: It's quite a popular spot among village lovers. It's quiet and a good place for a date.
scripts.translation: 那地方在村裡的情侶之間很受歡迎，既安靜又適合約會。

scripts.text: Recently, I haven't had much to laugh about because of various things, but thanks to you, I laughed out loud. I look forward to the next story.
scripts.translation: 最近各種煩心事讓我都笑不出來了，多虧你讓我開懷大笑。期待下次聽到你的故事。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about who was painting murals in the cave.
scripts.translation: 我把在洞穴裡畫壁畫的人告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: Have you ever met me when I was painting the mural? I don't remember, but...
scripts.translation: 你見過我畫壁畫嗎？我不記得了，不過......

scripts.text: I think I can tell you why I painted the mural.
scripts.translation: 我想我可以告訴你自己為什麼要畫那幅壁畫。

scripts.text: It's not much of a secret, but each of my brothers has a mysterious ability.
scripts.translation: 這不是什麼秘密，我的每個兄弟都有一種不可思議的能力。

scripts.text: In the case of Karoo-hyung, he has the ability to see accurately even from a distance..
scripts.translation: 比如卡魯哥哥，他能從很遠的地方看清事物......

scripts.text: Maknae Maru has an excellent memory that never forgets what she has seen and the ability to read her opponent's mind..
scripts.translation: 最小的瑪魯記憶力驚人，見過的東西都不會忘，還能讀懂對手的心思......

scripts.text: I'm not always correct, but I can see into the future. Ah! I have more abilities than that.
scripts.translation: 我雖然不能總是預測準確，卻能預見未來。啊，我還有別的能力呢。

scripts.text: I can see people's good and evil energy. In the case of adventurers...
scripts.translation: 我能看見人身上的善惡氣息。至於冒險者嘛......

scripts.text: I can feel the good energy that can't be touched. That's why I feel more bitter.
scripts.translation: 我能感受到那種看不見、摸不著的善意。所以才覺得格外苦澀。

scripts.text: Coming back to the original story, the reason I'm painting the mural is because one day I dreamed of a village burning down.
scripts.translation: 說回壁畫吧，我會畫它，是因為有一天夢見村莊被大火吞噬。

scripts.text: Many monsters have come to town and people are crying out in pain because of it...
scripts.translation: 許多魔物湧進村子，村民們痛苦地哀嚎......

scripts.text: After the hellish dream, I saw myself recording the day's events on a mural in a cave.
scripts.translation: 那場地獄般的夢之後，我又看見自己在洞穴壁畫上記錄那天發生的事。

scripts.text: Haha, don't worry too much. The dream hasn't happened yet.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，別太擔心，夢裡的事還沒發生呢。

scripts.text: Do you know? If I paint the mural in advance, will the future I saw in my dream change?
scripts.translation: 你說，要是我提前畫好壁畫，夢裡看到的未來會不會改變？

scripts.text: An adventurer I haven't seen in my dreams is helping us, so I'm sure we can change it.
scripts.translation: 有位我從沒在夢裡見過的冒險者正在幫助我們，所以我相信未來能改變。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about Mao, who was training alone.
scripts.translation: 我把毛獨自訓練的事告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: Mao guy... you've been thinking about a lot of things.
scripts.translation: 毛那傢伙......你倒是想了不少事啊。

scripts.text: Brother Karu lives separately from his sister-in-law, and we still live together, but I don't think he cared too much about his sister.
scripts.translation: 卡魯哥哥和嫂子分開住，我們還住在一起。不過我覺得他不怎麼關心妹妹。

scripts.text: It's said that I lost my mind after having a painful dream, but somehow my anxiety...
scripts.translation: 聽說我做了個痛苦的夢後就失去了理智，可不知為何，我還是覺得不安......

scripts.text: Looks like he's been infested with Mao. Maybe because of his abilities, he's often swayed by other people's emotions...
scripts.translation: 他似乎被毛的情緒影響了。也許是因為有那種能力，他總會受到別人的情緒左右......

scripts.text: He... training to become stronger... even if he doesn't become stronger... he's still enough...
scripts.translation: 他......為了變強而訓練......可就算沒變得更強......他也已經足夠好了......

scripts.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, I found out about Mao's troubles.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你，多虧了你，我知道了毛在煩惱什麼。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about someone who was taking something from the cave.
scripts.translation: 我把有人從洞穴裡拿走東西的事告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: You saw that too. I think we've talked about it before. In my dream, I saw monsters coming into town.
scripts.translation: 你也看見了啊。我們之前好像聊過這件事。我在夢裡見到魔物湧進了村莊。

scripts.text: And in preparation for that time, the village warriors evacuated the elderly and weak to this place, and they stored supplies here and there in the cave.
scripts.translation: 為了應對那一天，村裡的戰士把老人和體弱者疏散到這裡，還在洞穴各處藏了物資。

scripts.text: These are literally emergency items. It would be perfect if they were not used, but...
scripts.translation: 那些確實是應急物資。最好永遠都用不上，可是......

scripts.text: You don't know how the world works. If you find something, just ignore it.
scripts.translation: 你還不懂世事。看到什麼就當沒看見吧。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the villagers and the village chief.
scripts.translation: 我把遇見村民和村長的經過告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: You really came to see what happened a while ago. It wasn't as much damage as you saw in your dream, but it was a lot of damage.
scripts.translation: 你真的去看了那時發生的事。雖然沒你夢裡看到的那麼嚴重，損失還是很慘重。

scripts.text: When I think of that day, my heart hurts. All of a sudden, when my brothers were away...
scripts.translation: 一想到那天，我就心痛。兄弟們突然都不在身邊......

scripts.text: Still, the village chief, the best elder in the village, seems to have suffered less damage because he was calm. Thanks for the story.
scripts.translation: 不過村長是村裡最年長、最德高望重的人，幸好他當時保持冷靜，損失似乎小些。謝謝你告訴我這些。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the brothers who ran somewhere in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到匆忙離開的兄弟們的事告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: You must have seen the day my brothers and I came back from hunting. There was a big disaster in the village and it was the next day.
scripts.translation: 你看到的應該是我和兄弟們打獵回來那天。那場災難是在隔天發生的。

scripts.text: Kuh.. If me and my brothers hadn't emptied the village... the people wouldn't have been taken by the monsters...
scripts.translation: 咳......要是我和兄弟們沒把村民疏散出去，他們就會被魔物抓走......

scripts.text: I know. It's not because of me and my brothers.. but.. that day.. we.. .. .. it's just a pity
scripts.translation: 我知道。那不是我和兄弟們的錯......可是......那天我們......唉......真讓人難過。

scripts.text: You've shown me, adventurer, something I wouldn't have seen. I'm just here to tell you what I remember...
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你讓我看到了本來不可能看到的事。我只是在這裡告訴你我記得的事情......

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of seeing Karu and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 我把看到卡魯和阿蘇德姆的事告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: That's the reason why you shut yourself up in the west cave.
scripts.translation: ......所以你才把自己關在西邊的洞穴裡。

scripts.text: I feel resentful of myself for not being able to help with the village defense.
scripts.translation: 我怨恨自己沒能幫忙守護村莊。

scripts.text: Your heart... I can't even imagine your sister-in-law's... whoo... your sorrow...
scripts.translation: 你的心情......我甚至不敢想像嫂子有多難受......唉......你一定很悲痛......

scripts.text: When the situation here is sorted out, I will look for my older brother. He must be alone in pain and sorrow.
scripts.translation: 這裡的事情解決後，我要去找哥哥。他一定獨自承受著痛苦和悲傷。

scripts.text: My heart hurts like this too, but if you know the youngest who struggles because of his abilities... I'll have to prepare. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我自己也很難受，可還有個弟弟正因自己的能力而苦惱......我得振作起來。謝謝你，冒險者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: Told Luanda about stories of unknown people.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到一些陌生人的經歷告訴了盧安達。

scripts.text: It sounds like a conversation between a Wootan or Megalith monster targeting the village.
scripts.translation: 聽起來像是烏坦族或邪惡摩艾正打算襲擊村莊。

scripts.text: Follow a strong leader? Recently, I felt that the movements of these guys are disturbingly orderly...
scripts.translation: 要追隨強大的首領嗎？最近這些傢伙的行動確實整齊得反常......

scripts.text: It seems that a monster has appeared to lead them.
scripts.translation: 看來有個魔物出現，統領了它們。

scripts.text: It's embarrassing. Even now, all we can do is block it.
scripts.translation: 真慚愧。即使到了現在，我們也只能勉強擋住它們。

scripts.text: This is not the time to be sad. We need to build more defenses and take other measures.
scripts.translation: 現在不是難過的時候。我們得加強防禦，再想想別的辦法。

scripts.text: A strong leader is also a problem... but a power that has been handed down as a legend? This is a story I've never heard of before.
scripts.translation: 強大的首領已經夠棘手了......傳說中流傳下來的力量？我從沒聽過這種事。

scripts.text: I'm guessing this is the reason why the monsters are attacking the village, but I'll have to tell the chief and investigate.
scripts.translation: 這大概就是魔物襲擊村莊的原因。我得告訴村長，再調查清楚。

scripts.text: The story you just told me was really helpful. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 你剛才告訴我的事很有幫助。謝謝你，冒險者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達報告，獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text: It's a situation where even one request is regrettable, but {0}... really.
scripts.translation: 哪怕少接一份委託都讓人遺憾，不過......真 {0}

scripts.text: Each and every request is precious. Thank you again and again.
scripts.translation: 每一份委託都很重要。再次感謝你，辛苦了。

scripts.text: For quests that are recruiting in town, there is a separate request board.
scripts.translation: 城鎮裡的招募委託另有一塊公告板。

scripts.text: Ah! Watch your mind. The location is in the middle of the battlefield, so I installed it in the corner for safety reasons.
scripts.translation: 啊，注意安全！公告板原本在戰場中央，為了安全起見，我把它移到了角落。

scripts.text: There are cases where you cannot complete a request on the bulletin board right away, but there is no specific time limit, so don't be in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 公告板上的委託有時沒法馬上完成，不過沒有時限，不用著急。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you are really curious about everything.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你對什麼都很好奇啊。

scripts.text: The Luanda Caves are strategically the only way out north of town.
scripts.translation: 盧安達洞窟是城鎮北面的唯一通道，戰略位置很重要。

scripts.text: That's why we're defending against monster attacks here.
scripts.translation: 所以我們才在這裡抵禦魔物的襲擊。

scripts.text: Ah! Did you notice? Yes, my name is Luanda too. The village elders say...
scripts.translation: 啊，被你發現了？沒錯，我也叫盧安達。村裡的長老說......

scripts.text: The triplets are said to have been named Karu, Luanda, and Mao after the village caves.
scripts.translation: 據說三胞胎卡魯、盧安達和毛，是以村裡的洞窟命名的。

scripts.text: My neighborhood friends teased me a bit when I was young, but I don't have any complaints about the name.
scripts.translation: 小時候，附近的朋友偶爾會拿這個名字開玩笑，不過我並不介意。

scripts.text: I heard they were named after the guardians of the village. I'm rather proud of them.
scripts.translation: 聽說這些洞窟是村莊的守護者，我還挺為名字感到自豪的。

scripts.text: It's very puzzling to us too. If we knew why, we'd have put everything away.
scripts.translation: 我們也不清楚原因，實在令人費解。要是知道怎麼回事，早就想辦法解決了。

scripts.text: This isn't a town with plenty of food, and I don't think there's any particular reason for monsters to target it.
scripts.translation: 這裡食物並不充裕，我不覺得魔物是為了什麼特別的理由盯上村莊。

scripts.text: But what can we do? We're just living here, and the monsters keep coming, so we have to live while blocking them.
scripts.translation: 可我們又能怎麼辦？我們住在這裡，魔物卻不斷來襲，只能一邊抵擋一邊過日子。

scripts.text: It's a bizarre shimmer that you're likely to be sucked into.
scripts.translation: 這是一道奇異的閃光，似乎會把人吸進去。

scripts.text: It seems like a phenomenon that can't be ignored. I'll have to talk to Luanda, the head of defense.
scripts.translation: 這種現象不能置之不理。我得去找防衛負責人盧安達談談。

scripts.text: What's up? I'm busy right now, so I'll talk to you later.
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？我現在有點忙，晚些再聊。

scripts.text: What's up? I'm a bit busy right now...
Ah, you're the one introduced by Raket. I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 啊，你就是拉凱特介紹來的那位吧。我等你好久了。

scripts.text: Can you show me your fishing rod?
scripts.translation: 能讓我看看你的魚竿嗎？

scripts.text: - Jerrymon began to examine the rod closely. -
scripts.translation: - 傑裡蒙開始仔細檢查魚竿。 -

scripts.text: Yes, that's right... this substance is just that... to discover it again like this...
scripts.translation: 沒錯......就是這種物質......竟然又發現了......

scripts.text: What material are you talking about?
Adventurer, do you know where the deepest part of the sea is?
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你知道海洋最深處在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text: It is a place called the ^4d4dffTrench^000000. To put it simply, you can think of it as a deep cliff in the sea.
scripts.translation: 那個地方叫海溝。簡單來說，就像海底的一道深淵。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: It is known that there are hundreds of different types of trenches in the world's oceans.
scripts.translation: 據說世界上的海洋裡有數百條不同的海溝。

scripts.text: The widest and deepest known trench is the ^4d4dffBahia Trench^000000 near Izlude.
scripts.translation: 目前已知最寬、最深的海溝，是依斯魯得附近的巴伊亞海溝。 ^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: There are rare life forms at the bottom of the trench, and marine scientists like myself have shown great interest and have been exploring them.
scripts.translation: 海溝底部棲息著稀有生物。我和其他海洋學家對此很感興趣，一直在研究它們。

scripts.text: Though shallow trenches can be explored to some extent.
scripts.translation: 淺海溝多少還能探索一番。

scripts.text: But in the case of the Bahia Trench, scientists have calculated that scientifically, no life can exist because it is so incredibly deep.
scripts.translation: 但巴伊亞海溝深不可測，科學家認為那裡不可能存在生命。

scripts.text: I recently found out that there is life in the Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation: 最近我卻發現，巴伊亞海溝裡真的有生命。

scripts.text: You can tell by the stone that contains my magic.
scripts.translation: 從這塊蘊含我魔力的石頭就能看出來。

scripts.text: Yes, I'm a mage-turned-oceanographer. I learned magic for oceanography.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我原本是魔法師，後來轉行研究海洋。學習魔法就是為了做海洋研究。

scripts.text: Enchant a large boulder and make it fall to the floor where the trench exists.
scripts.translation: 我在巨石上施加魔法，再讓它沉到海溝底部。

scripts.text: The magic on the dropped stone is connected to me, so by measuring the distance, I can get a little idea of how deep it is and what's going on near the stone.
scripts.translation: 沉下去的石頭上的魔法會與我相連。通過測量距離，我就能大致判斷海溝有多深，以及石頭附近的狀況。

scripts.text: To tell you what I found out...
scripts.translation: 我來告訴你發現了什麼......

scripts.text: The composition of normal sea water and deep sea water is almost the same. But the only difference is the deep sea of Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation: 一般海水和深海海水的成分幾乎相同，但巴伊亞海溝深處的海水卻不一樣。

scripts.text: Should I say it's like water and oil? There's a section where they never mix.
scripts.translation: 該怎麼形容呢？就像水和油一樣，有一層介面讓兩者永遠無法混合。

scripts.text: A strong boundary was formed where they meet each other, and it felt as if the deep seawater in that section was desperately blocking the seawater coming down from above.
scripts.translation: 兩種海水交界處形成了強力屏障，彷彿那裡的深海水在拼命抵擋上方的海水。

scripts.text: The water pressure is also much lower than that of normal seawater, so it is assumed that it has a favorable environment for life.
scripts.translation: 那裡的水壓也低得多，所以我推測環境適合生命生存。

scripts.text: Is this gloss related to what you said?
scripts.translation: 這種光澤和你剛才說的發現有關嗎？

scripts.text: We only identified the existence of Abyssal Seawater deep in the Bahia Trench, and it was very difficult to obtain samples. This fishing rod has a lot of Abyssal Seawater on it...
scripts.translation: 這樣！我們只在巴伊亞海溝深處確認過深淵海水的存在，而且很難採集樣本。這根魚竿上卻沾了不少......

scripts.text: Could you leave this fishing rod with me? I think I can figure something out if I extract this sea water and turn it into essence.
scripts.translation: 能把這根魚竿留給我嗎？我想提取海水並製成精華，說不定能查出些什麼。

scripts.text: Oh, and I heard that the fishing rod was found today. Can I ask you to check if there is another floating substance in the nearby sea?
scripts.translation: 對了，聽說這根魚竿是今天才發現的。能幫我檢查一下附近海域，看看有沒有其他漂浮物嗎？

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy right now...
Please come back to me when you're done!
Yes, thanks! I'll be waiting for you!!
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打擾你，不過拜託了。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打擾你，不過拜託了。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: Hey, could you take a look at this?
See those two little water bottles here?
scripts.translation: 看到這兩小瓶海水了嗎？

scripts.text: One side is normal seawater, and the other side is seawater mixed with seawater from the abyss buried in fishing rods. I'll try mixing these two.
scripts.translation: 一瓶是普通海水，另一瓶混有從魚竿上提取的深淵海水。我來試著把它們混在一起。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon poured both waters into one bottle and began to shake them together. -
scripts.translation: - 傑裡蒙把兩種海水倒進同一瓶裡，開始搖晃。 -

scripts.text: Now, look. As I said before, they don't mix at all, do they?
scripts.translation: 看到了嗎？正如我剛才說的，兩種水完全混不到一起。

scripts.text: If you shake it like crazy!!

scripts.translation: 嗚哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊......

scripts.text: Oh, I'm going to catch someone, is it okay?
scripts.translation: 等等，我要去抓個人，可以嗎？

scripts.text: - Looking into the bottle Jerrymon is holding, I can clearly see the shape of the vortex. -
scripts.translation: - 仔細看著傑裡蒙手裡的瓶子，我清楚地看見了漩渦的形狀。 -

scripts.text: Now, do you see this whirlpool!! This is the passage that connects to the bottom of the Bahia Trench!
scripts.translation: 看見這個漩渦了嗎？！這就是通往巴伊亞海溝底部的通道！

scripts.text: ??? Isn't that just a whirlpool created by shaking it?
No. This is the stone that contains my magical power. Let's look at it.
scripts.translation: 不是。這塊石頭蘊含著我的魔力，你看。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon put a glowing stone into the bottle. The glowing stone was sucked into the whirlpool inside the bottle and disappeared without a trace! -
scripts.translation: - 傑裡蒙把發光的石頭放進瓶裡。石頭被瓶中的漩渦吸了進去，轉眼消失得無影無蹤！ -

scripts.text: Did I ever tell you that the stone that contains my magic can measure the distance to me?
scripts.translation: 我有告訴過你嗎？蘊含我魔力的石頭可以測量它與我之間的距離。

scripts.text: It feels the same as the last time I threw a pebble into the Bahia Trench..
scripts.translation: 感覺和上次我把石子扔進巴伊亞海溝時一樣..

scripts.text: If you follow this whirlpool, you may be able to find the owner of the fishing rod.
scripts.translation: ....順著這個漩渦走，或許能找到魚竿的主人。

scripts.text: The problem is... the amount of essence on a fishing rod can't make a whirlpool large enough for a person to fit in.
scripts.translation: 問題是......魚竿上的精華不夠多，無法形成足以讓人通過的漩渦。

scripts.text: - Showed the ^4d4dff{0}^000000 received from Gein to Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 把從蓋因那裡拿到的展示給傑裡蒙。 - ^4d4dff{0}^000000

scripts.text: Oh, just in case, I actually found it!
With this amount, I think I can create a vortex of fissures that normal people can enter. You can pass it to me.
scripts.translation: 有了這些，我應該能製造出普通人也能進入的裂隙漩渦。把它交給我吧。

scripts.text: The place is too small to do this much here, so let's do it in Izlude. In order to get help from your friends.
scripts.translation: 這裡空間太小，施展不開。我們去依斯魯得島吧，也好找你的朋友們幫忙。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打擾你了，不過拜託了。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: I thought I'd never come back...
scripts.translation: 我還以為自己再也回不來了......

scripts.text: Hello, my name is Soup, a friend of Sirood who is missing.
scripts.translation: 你好，我叫湯，是失蹤者西魯德的朋友。

scripts.text: The four of us, Sirood, Raket, Gein, and I often enjoyed fishing.
scripts.translation: 我們四個人——西魯德、拉凱特、蓋因和我——經常一起釣魚。

scripts.text: That windy day... I had been feeling very guilty for not stopping Sirood from going fishing.
scripts.translation: 那天風雨交加......我一直很自責，沒能攔住西魯德去釣魚。

scripts.text: When I heard that Sirood's fishing pole was found, I jumped out.
scripts.translation: 聽說找到了西魯德的魚竿，我立刻趕了過來。

scripts.text: You must have a clue about something?
scripts.translation: 你一定找到什麼線索了吧？
希望西魯德能平安回來。
西魯德已經回到我們身邊了。

scripts.text: Thanks to you, adventurer. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation: 多虧了你，冒險者。真的太感謝了。

scripts.text: It's been exactly 3 months since Sirood went missing.
scripts.translation: 西魯德失蹤到現在，正好三個月了。

scripts.text: Why is this only discovered now, isn't this a message from someone?
scripts.translation: 為什麼偏偏現在才發現？會不會是有人留下了什麼訊息？

scripts.text: Looking at it, it doesn't make sense.
Ha... It's just my delusion. I especially miss that child today.
scripts.translation: 唉......大概只是我想多了。尤其是今天，我特別想念那孩子。

scripts.text: Heh heh... It's so hard to use all your strength...
scripts.translation: 呵呵......要使出全力還真不容易......

scripts.text: Now you can fish with Sirood again.
scripts.translation: 現在你又能和西魯德一起釣魚了。

scripts.text: Please clean up your items and try again.
Haha... why did this only get discovered now??
scripts.translation: 哈哈......為什麼偏偏現在才找到？！不

scripts.text: - I feel serious anguish from this person. Let's come back after I've become level 140. -
scripts.translation: - 我感受到他心中強烈的痛苦。等達到140級後再回來吧。 -

scripts.text: Haha...why did this only get discovered now??
scripts.translation: 哈哈......為什麼偏偏現在才找到？！不

scripts.text: - He is very fidgety with a fishing pole in his hand. It doesn't look like he's out fishing. -
scripts.translation: - 他手裡握著魚竿，顯得坐立不安。看起來不像是來釣魚的。 -

scripts.text: This fishing rod belongs to my friend Sirood who went missing three months ago. I found something!!!
scripts.translation: 這根魚竿屬於我那位失蹤三個月的朋友西魯德。我找到線索了！！！

scripts.text: Yes... Sirood is a fishing fanatic and came here to fish whenever he had a chance.
scripts.translation: 是啊......西魯德是個釣魚迷，一有空就會來這裡釣魚。

scripts.text: Influenced by Sirood, we also fell in love with fishing, and the four of us often had a good time.
scripts.translation: 受他的影響，我們也愛上了釣魚。我們四個人常常一起玩得很開心。

scripts.text: Sirood's passion for fishing was to the point that he invited us to go fishing even in the rain and wind.
scripts.translation: 西魯德痴迷釣魚，就算颳風下雨也會約我們出來。

scripts.text: The day Sirood went missing was exactly the same rainy and windy day. I put on my raincoat and went to go fishing.
scripts.translation: 西魯德失蹤那天，正好也是個風雨交加的日子。我穿上雨衣，準備去釣魚。

scripts.text: We were invited to go out together, but they all declined.
scripts.translation: 他約我們一起出門，可大家都拒絕了。

scripts.text: Sirood went fishing alone and we haven't seen him since...
scripts.translation: 西魯德只好獨自去釣魚，從那以後我們就再也沒見過他......

scripts.text: I should have stopped you from leaving...
